chapters.title: Deha-Rasayana — The Body as Sacred Elixir-Vessel
chapters.summary: The foundational philosophy: treating the body as an indispensable divine instrument (yantra) for yoga. Purification of the seven dhatus, balance of doshas, and digestive metabolic fire (agni).

verses.sanskrit: योगनिद्रां समासाद्य यः शेते शेषविष्टरे । तस्य पादांबुजं नित्यं देवस्य प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥ १ ॥
verses.transliteration: yoganidrāṃ samāsādya yaḥ śete śeṣaviṣṭare | tasya pādāṃbujaṃ nityaṃ devasya praṇamāmyaham || 1 ||
verses.translation: I bow always to the lotus feet of the Lord who, sunk in yogic sleep, rests on the couch of Shesha.
verses.hindi: जो योगनिद्रा में लीन होकर शेषनाग की शय्या पर शयन करते हैं, उन भगवान के चरण-कमलों को मैं सदा प्रणाम करता हूँ।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: योगिराजं शिवं चापि नत्वा गुरुपदांबुजम् । योगाचार्यानशेषेण योगं वक्ष्यामि सिद्धये ॥ २ ॥
verses.transliteration: yogirājaṃ śivaṃ cāpi natvā gurupadāṃbujam | yogācāryānaśeṣeṇa yogaṃ vakṣyāmi siddhaye || 2 ||
verses.translation: Bowing to Shiva, king of yogis, to my teacher's lotus feet and to all the masters of yoga, I shall describe yoga for the sake of attainment.
verses.hindi: योगियों के राजा शिव को और गुरु के चरण-कमलों को, तथा सभी योगाचार्यों को प्रणाम करके, मैं सिद्धि के लिए योग का वर्णन करूँगा।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणापानसमायोगो योगश्चित्तात्मनोस्तथा । यत्र जीवेशयोर्योगस्तं योगं नित्यमभ्यसेत् ॥ ३ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇāpānasamāyogo yogaścittātmanostathā | yatra jīveśayoryogastaṃ yogaṃ nityamabhyaset || 3 ||
verses.translation: The union of prana and apana is yoga, and so is the union of mind and self; one should practise daily that yoga in which the individual soul unites with the Lord.
verses.hindi: प्राण और अपान का मिलन योग है, चित्त और आत्मा का मिलन भी योग है; जिसमें जीव और ईश्वर का मिलन होता है, उस योग का नित्य अभ्यास करना चाहिए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: क्रियाजालान्यनेकानि प्रभवंति न मुक्तये । योगमेवाभ्यसेन्नित्यं बुधो मोक्षाय केवलम् ॥ ४ ॥
verses.transliteration: kriyājālānyanekāni prabhavaṃti na muktaye | yogamevābhyasennityaṃ budho mokṣāya kevalam || 4 ||
verses.translation: The many tangles of ritual cannot bring liberation. So the wise should practise yoga daily, solely for the sake of freedom.
verses.hindi: अनेक प्रकार के कर्मकाण्ड मुक्ति नहीं दे सकते। इसलिए बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति केवल मोक्ष के लिए नित्य योग का ही अभ्यास करे।

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वज्ञानेन कैवल्यं ज्ञानं योगमयं तथा । विना योगेन यज्ज्ञानं नैव तन्मोक्षकारणम् ॥ ५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tattvajñānena kaivalyaṃ jñānaṃ yogamayaṃ tathā | vinā yogena yajjñānaṃ naiva tanmokṣakāraṇam || 5 ||
verses.translation: Liberation comes from knowing the truth, and that knowledge is made of yoga. Knowledge without yoga is never a cause of liberation.
verses.hindi: तत्त्व के ज्ञान से कैवल्य मिलता है, और वह ज्ञान योग से ही बनता है। योग के बिना जो ज्ञान है, वह मोक्ष का कारण नहीं होता।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अणिमादिपदं येन प्राप्य जित्वा तथांतकम् । जीवन्मुक्तश्चरेद्योगी योगमार्गं तमाश्रयेत् ॥ ६ ॥
verses.transliteration: aṇimādipadaṃ yena prāpya jitvā tathāṃtakam | jīvanmuktaścaredyogī yogamārgaṃ tamāśrayet || 6 ||
verses.translation: Take refuge in the path of yoga by which a yogi gains powers such as becoming minute, conquers death, and moves about liberated while alive.
verses.hindi: जिस मार्ग से अणिमा आदि सिद्धियाँ पाकर और मृत्यु को जीतकर योगी जीवन्मुक्त होकर विचरता है, उसी योगमार्ग का आश्रय लेना चाहिए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: शुष्कशास्त्रविवादेषु नैवायुः क्षपयेद्बुधः । नहि दीपकवार्तायामंधकारो विनश्यति ॥ ७ ॥
verses.transliteration: śuṣkaśāstravivādeṣu naivāyuḥ kṣapayedbudhaḥ | nahi dīpakavārtāyāmaṃdhakāro vinaśyati || 7 ||
verses.translation: The wise should not waste their life on dry debates over texts, for darkness does not vanish by talking about a lamp.
verses.hindi: बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति सूखे शास्त्रार्थ और विवादों में अपनी आयु न गँवाए, क्योंकि दीपक की बातें करने से अँधेरा नहीं मिटता।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियार्थेषु सक्तानां देहाध्यासवतां नृणाम् । आलस्यहतबुद्धीनां शास्त्रं स्याद्वलंबनम् ॥ ८ ॥
verses.transliteration: indriyārtheṣu saktānāṃ dehādhyāsavatāṃ nṛṇām | ālasyahatabuddhīnāṃ śāstraṃ syādvalaṃbanam || 8 ||
verses.translation: For people attached to sense objects, who take the body for the self and whose minds are dulled by sloth, scripture is a support.
verses.hindi: जो लोग इन्द्रियों के विषयों में आसक्त हैं, जो देह को ही आत्मा मानते हैं और जिनकी बुद्धि आलस्य से मारी गई है, उनके लिए शास्त्र सहारा है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्माच्छास्त्रं विचार्यादौ पश्चाद्योगं समभ्यसेत् । यथा पूर्वर्षयश्चक्रुर्वसिष्ठाद्याः शुकादयः ॥ ९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmācchāstraṃ vicāryādau paścādyogaṃ samabhyaset | yathā pūrvarṣayaścakrurvasiṣṭhādyāḥ śukādayaḥ || 9 ||
verses.translation: So first reflect on scripture, then practise yoga, as Vasishtha, Shuka and the sages of old did.
verses.hindi: इसलिए पहले शास्त्र पर विचार करे और फिर योग का अभ्यास करे, जैसा वसिष्ठ आदि और शुक आदि प्राचीन ऋषियों ने किया।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: शैववैष्णवशाक्तेषु मतेषु निखिलेष्वपि । सर्वत्र विहितो योगस्ततस्तं साधयेत्सुधीः ॥ १० ॥
verses.transliteration: śaivavaiṣṇavaśākteṣu mateṣu nikhileṣvapi | sarvatra vihito yogastatastaṃ sādhayetsudhīḥ || 10 ||
verses.translation: Yoga is enjoined everywhere, in the Shaiva, Vaishnava and Shakta paths and in all other schools; so the wise should practise it.
verses.hindi: शैव, वैष्णव, शाक्त और अन्य सभी मतों में योग का विधान किया गया है; इसलिए बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति उसकी साधना करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: आलोक्य योगशास्त्राणि स्वस्यानुभवतस्तथा । सारभूतं प्रवक्ष्यामि विधानं योगसाधने ॥ ११ ॥
verses.transliteration: ālokya yogaśāstrāṇi svasyānubhavatastathā | sārabhūtaṃ pravakṣyāmi vidhānaṃ yogasādhane || 11 ||
verses.translation: Having studied the texts of yoga and drawing on my own experience, I shall set out the essential method of practising yoga.
verses.hindi: योग के शास्त्रों को देखकर और अपने अनुभव के आधार पर, मैं योग-साधना की सार-रूप विधि बताऊँगा।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: तत्र योगविधौ ज्ञेयं द्वाराणां तु चतुष्टयम् । विनेश्वरानुग्रहाज्जंतोर्दुर्लभं यस्य कस्यचित् ॥ १२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatra yogavidhau jñeyaṃ dvārāṇāṃ tu catuṣṭayam | vineśvarānugrahājjaṃtordurlabhaṃ yasya kasyacit || 12 ||
verses.translation: In this method of yoga one should know four gateways. Without the Lord's grace they are hard for anyone to find.
verses.hindi: उस योग-विधि में चार द्वार जानने चाहिए। ईश्वर की कृपा के बिना ये किसी भी प्राणी को मिलना कठिन है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं विषयत्यागो द्वितीयमनुकूलता । तृतीयं गुरुसंयोगश्चतुर्थं चेश्वरार्चनम् ॥ १३ ॥
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ viṣayatyāgo dvitīyamanukūlatā | tṛtīyaṃ gurusaṃyogaścaturthaṃ ceśvarārcanam || 13 ||
verses.translation: The first is giving up sense pleasures, the second favourable conditions, the third meeting a teacher, and the fourth worship of the Lord.
verses.hindi: पहला है विषयों का त्याग, दूसरा अनुकूल परिस्थिति, तीसरा गुरु का साथ और चौथा ईश्वर की पूजा।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: द्वाराण्येतानि योगस्य चत्वारि मुनयो विदुः । तैर्विना भवेत्सिद्धिर्न जन्मकोटिभिरपि ॥ १४ ॥
verses.transliteration: dvārāṇyetāni yogasya catvāri munayo viduḥ | tairvinā bhavetsiddhirna janmakoṭibhirapi || 14 ||
verses.translation: The sages know these as the four gateways of yoga. Without them there is no success even in ten million births.
verses.hindi: मुनि इन्हें योग के चार द्वार जानते हैं। इनके बिना करोड़ों जन्मों में भी सिद्धि नहीं मिलती।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: तथाष्टावेव योगस्य ज्ञेयान्यंगानि साधकैः । येषां साधनतो जंतुः कैवल्यं पदमश्नुते ॥ १५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tathāṣṭāveva yogasya jñeyānyaṃgāni sādhakaiḥ | yeṣāṃ sādhanato jaṃtuḥ kaivalyaṃ padamaśnute || 15 ||
verses.translation: Seekers should also know the eight limbs of yoga, by practising which a person reaches the state of liberation.
verses.hindi: साधकों को योग के आठ अंग भी जानने चाहिए, जिनकी साधना से प्राणी कैवल्य पद को पाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: यमश्च नियमश्च स्यादासनं प्राणसंयमः । प्रत्याहारस्तथा पश्चाद्धारणा ध्यानमेव च ॥ १६ ॥
verses.transliteration: yamaśca niyamaśca syādāsanaṃ prāṇasaṃyamaḥ | pratyāhārastathā paścāddhāraṇā dhyānameva ca || 16 ||
verses.translation: Restraint, observance, posture, breath control, then withdrawal of the senses, concentration and meditation,
verses.hindi: यम, नियम, आसन, प्राणायाम, फिर प्रत्याहार, धारणा और ध्यान,
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: समाधिरिति योगस्य विदुरंगानि योगिनः । लक्षणं च क्रमात्तेषामुच्यते मुनिसंमतम् ॥ १७ ॥
verses.transliteration: samādhiriti yogasya viduraṃgāni yoginaḥ | lakṣaṇaṃ ca kramātteṣāmucyate munisaṃmatam || 17 ||
verses.translation: and absorption: these the yogis know as the limbs of yoga. Their marks are now given in order, as the sages accept them.
verses.hindi: और समाधि, इन्हें योगी योग के अंग मानते हैं। अब क्रम से उनके लक्षण बताए जाते हैं, जो मुनियों को मान्य हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यापरिग्रहौ । यमः पंचविधः प्रोक्तो मुनिभिर्योगचिन्तकैः ॥ १८ ॥
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau | yamaḥ paṃcavidhaḥ prokto munibhiryogacintakaiḥ || 18 ||
verses.translation: Non-violence, truthfulness, not stealing, celibacy and non-possession: the sages who reflect on yoga describe restraint as fivefold.
verses.hindi: अहिंसा, सत्य, अस्तेय (चोरी न करना), ब्रह्मचर्य और अपरिग्रह, योग पर विचार करने वाले मुनियों ने यम को इन पाँच प्रकार का बताया है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: अहिंसा सर्वभूतानां सर्वथा द्रोहवर्जनम् । सत्यं स्याज्जीवजातस्य हितं वाक्यं प्रियं च यत् ॥ १९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ahiṃsā sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvathā drohavarjanam | satyaṃ syājjīvajātasya hitaṃ vākyaṃ priyaṃ ca yat || 19 ||
verses.translation: Non-violence is never harming any being in any way. Truthfulness is speech that is beneficial and pleasant to living beings.
verses.hindi: सब प्राणियों से किसी भी प्रकार का द्रोह न करना अहिंसा है। जो वचन प्राणियों के लिए हितकारी और प्रिय हो, वह सत्य है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.translation: Not stealing is not taking others' things without permission. Complete abstinence from sex is called celibacy.

verses.translation: Not accumulating things other than what yoga requires: this the greatest sages call non-possession.

verses.translation: Non-violence brings friendship with all; truthfulness makes one's word unfailing; not stealing brings jewels; celibacy brings strength.
verses.hindi: अहिंसा से सबसे मित्रता होती है, सत्य से वाणी अमोघ (कभी व्यर्थ न जाने वाली) होती है, अस्तेय से रत्न मिलते हैं और ब्रह्मचर्य से बल मिलता है।

verses.sanskrit: अपरिग्रहणादात्मविचारो जायते ध्रुवम् । योगिनो यतचित्तस्य यमानां परिपाकतः ॥ २३ ॥

verses.translation: When the restraints ripen in a yogi of controlled mind, non-possession surely gives rise to inquiry into the self.
verses.hindi: संयमित चित्त वाले योगी में यमों के परिपक्व होने पर अपरिग्रह से निश्चय ही आत्म-विचार उत्पन्न होता है।

verses.sanskrit: शौचं तोषस्तपश्चैव जपश्चेश्वरचिंतनम् । पंचधा नियमश्चापि विज्ञेयः साधकोत्तमैः ॥ २४ ॥
verses.transliteration: śaucaṃ toṣastapaścaiva japaśceśvaraciṃtanam | paṃcadhā niyamaścāpi vijñeyaḥ sādhakottamaiḥ || 24 ||
verses.translation: Purity, contentment, austerity, repetition of mantra and contemplation of the Lord: the best seekers should know observance as fivefold too.
verses.hindi: शौच, सन्तोष, तप, जप और ईश्वर का चिन्तन, श्रेष्ठ साधकों को नियम भी पाँच प्रकार का जानना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: शौचं शुद्धिर्हि देहस्य मनसश्च निगद्यते । यथालाभेन तुष्टिस्तु संतोषः परिकीर्तितः ॥ २५ ॥
verses.transliteration: śaucaṃ śuddhirhi dehasya manasaśca nigadyate | yathālābhena tuṣṭistu saṃtoṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 25 ||
verses.translation: Purity means cleanliness of body and mind. Being satisfied with whatever comes is called contentment.
verses.hindi: शरीर और मन की शुद्धि को शौच कहते हैं। जो मिल जाए उसी में तृप्त रहना सन्तोष कहलाता है।

verses.sanskrit: तपश्चान्द्रायणादीनां व्रतानां यद्विधारणम् । प्रणवादिपवित्रस्य मंत्रस्यावर्तनं जपः ॥ २६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tapaścāndrāyaṇādīnāṃ vratānāṃ yadvidhāraṇam | praṇavādipavitrasya maṃtrasyāvartanaṃ japaḥ || 26 ||
verses.translation: Austerity is keeping vows such as the lunar fast. Repetition is the repeated recitation of a sacred mantra beginning with Om.
verses.hindi: चान्द्रायण आदि व्रतों का पालन तप है। प्रणव (ॐ) आदि पवित्र मन्त्रों को बार-बार दोहराना जप है।

verses.sanskrit: मनसा भक्तिभावेन यदीशस्य निरंतरम् । स्मरणं सर्वगत्वेन तदेवेश्वरचिंतनम् ॥ २७ ॥
verses.transliteration: manasā bhaktibhāvena yadīśasya niraṃtaram | smaraṇaṃ sarvagatvena tadeveśvaraciṃtanam || 27 ||
verses.translation: Contemplation of the Lord is remembering him without break, in the mind and with devotion, as present everywhere.
verses.hindi: मन से भक्ति-भाव के साथ ईश्वर को सर्वव्यापी जानकर निरन्तर याद करना ही ईश्वर-चिन्तन है।

verses.sanskrit: शौचाद्देहे विरागः स्यात्संतोषादुत्तमं सुखम् । तपसा सिद्धिलाभश्च जपाद्देवसमागमः ॥ २८ ॥
verses.transliteration: śaucāddehe virāgaḥ syātsaṃtoṣāduttamaṃ sukham | tapasā siddhilābhaśca japāddevasamāgamaḥ || 28 ||
verses.translation: Purity brings detachment from the body; contentment the highest happiness; austerity attainment; repetition the meeting with one's deity.
verses.hindi: शौच से शरीर के प्रति वैराग्य होता है, सन्तोष से उत्तम सुख मिलता है, तप से सिद्धि मिलती है और जप से इष्टदेव का दर्शन होता है।

verses.transliteration: īśvarārādhanātsiddhiḥ samādherjāyate dhruvam | yogino niyamānāṃ ca paripāke na saṃśayaḥ || 29 ||
verses.translation: When the observances ripen, worship of the Lord surely brings the yogi success in absorption; there is no doubt of it.
verses.hindi: नियमों के परिपक्व होने पर, योगी को ईश्वर की आराधना से निश्चय ही समाधि की सिद्धि होती है; इसमें कोई सन्देह नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: यमैश्च नियमैश्चापि योग्यः स्याद्योगसाधने । अनादरेण चैतेषां न कचित्सिद्धिभाग्भवेत् ॥ ३० ॥

verses.translation: Restraints and observances make one fit to practise yoga. Neglecting them, one never gains any success.
verses.hindi: यमों और नियमों से मनुष्य योग-साधना के योग्य बनता है। इनका अनादर करने से कभी कोई सिद्धि नहीं मिलती।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादतिप्रयत्नेन सेवनीया निरंतरम् । यमाश्च नियमाश्चापि योगेप्सुभिरखंडिताः ॥ ३१ ॥

verses.translation: So those who seek yoga should keep the restraints and observances constantly, with great effort and without a break.
verses.hindi: इसलिए योग चाहने वालों को बड़े प्रयत्न से, बिना टूटे, निरन्तर यमों और नियमों का पालन करना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: आसनानि बहून्याहुर्मुनयो जीवभेदतः । तेषां चतुष्कमादाय सारभूतमिहोच्यते ॥ ३२ ॥

verses.translation: The sages describe many postures, as many as there are kinds of creatures. Four of them, the essential ones, are given here.
verses.hindi: मुनियों ने प्राणियों के भेद के अनुसार बहुत से आसन बताए हैं। उनमें से चार सार-रूप आसन यहाँ बताए जाते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धासनं भवेदाद्यं द्वितीयं पद्मसंज्ञितम् । तृतीयं स्वस्तिकं प्रोक्तं वीराख्यं च चतुर्थकम् ॥ ३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: siddhāsanaṃ bhavedādyaṃ dvitīyaṃ padmasaṃjñitam | tṛtīyaṃ svastikaṃ proktaṃ vīrākhyaṃ ca caturthakam || 33 ||
verses.translation: The first is the accomplished pose, the second the lotus, the third the auspicious pose, and the fourth the hero pose.
verses.hindi: पहला सिद्धासन है, दूसरा पद्मासन, तीसरा स्वस्तिकासन और चौथा वीरासन।

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धं प्राणाधिरोहे स्यात् ध्यानकाले तु पद्मकम् । स्वस्तिकं जपवेलायां वीरं स्यात्सुखसंस्थितौ ॥ ३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: siddhaṃ prāṇādhirohe syāt dhyānakāle tu padmakam | svastikaṃ japavelāyāṃ vīraṃ syātsukhasaṃsthitau || 34 ||
verses.translation: The accomplished pose suits raising the breath, the lotus meditation, the auspicious pose mantra repetition, and the hero pose sitting at ease.
verses.hindi: प्राण को ऊपर चढ़ाते समय सिद्धासन, ध्यान के समय पद्मासन, जप के समय स्वस्तिकासन और आराम से बैठने के लिए वीरासन उचित है।

verses.sanskrit: गुदावृषणयोर्मध्ये वामपार्ष्णिं नियोजयेत् । दक्षपादाग्रभागं च वामजंघांतरे न्यसेत् ॥ ३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: gudāvṛṣaṇayormadhye vāmapārṣṇiṃ niyojayet | dakṣapādāgrabhāgaṃ ca vāmajaṃghāṃtare nyaset || 35 ||
verses.translation: Place the left heel between the anus and the scrotum, and set the front of the right foot between the left thigh and calf.
verses.hindi: बाईं एड़ी को गुदा और अण्डकोष के बीच लगाए, और दाहिने पैर के अगले भाग को बाईं जाँघ और पिंडली के बीच रखे।

verses.sanskrit: हस्तयुग्मं न्यसेदंके सिद्धासनमितीरितम् । कुंडलीबोधकं शीघ्रं समाधेश्चोपकारकम् ॥ ३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: hastayugmaṃ nyasedaṃke siddhāsanamitīritam | kuṃḍalībodhakaṃ śīghraṃ samādheścopakārakam || 36 ||
verses.translation: Rest both hands in the lap: this is called the accomplished pose. It quickly awakens kundalini and helps absorption.
verses.hindi: दोनों हाथ गोद में रखे; इसे सिद्धासन कहा गया है। यह कुण्डलिनी को शीघ्र जगाता है और समाधि में सहायक है।

verses.sanskrit: वामोरूपरि दक्षांघ्रिं विन्यसेत्तस्य चोपरि । दक्षोरौ वामपदं च संस्थाप्यांजलिसंपुटम् ॥ ३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: vāmorūpari dakṣāṃghriṃ vinyasettasya copari | dakṣorau vāmapadaṃ ca saṃsthāpyāṃjalisaṃpuṭam || 37 ||
verses.translation: Place the right foot on the left thigh and over it the left foot on the right thigh, and join the hands in a cupped gesture;
verses.hindi: बाईं जाँघ पर दाहिना पैर रखे और उसके ऊपर दाहिनी जाँघ पर बायाँ पैर रखकर, हाथों को अंजलि की तरह जोड़े,

verses.sanskrit: स्वांके निधाय नासाग्रं पश्येन्निश्चलमानसः । पद्मासनं भवेदेतद्योगसिद्धिकरं परम् ॥ ३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: svāṃke nidhāya nāsāgraṃ paśyenniścalamānasaḥ | padmāsanaṃ bhavedetadyogasiddhikaraṃ param || 38 ||
verses.translation: resting them in the lap, gaze at the tip of the nose with a steady mind. This is the lotus pose, the best for success in yoga.
verses.hindi: उन्हें अपनी गोद में रखकर, स्थिर मन से नाक के अगले भाग को देखे। यह पद्मासन है, जो योग की सिद्धि देने वाला श्रेष्ठ आसन है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षजंघांतरे वामं वामजंघांतरे तथा । विन्यसेच्चरणं दक्षं स्वस्तिकं चैतदुच्यते ॥ ३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: dakṣajaṃghāṃtare vāmaṃ vāmajaṃghāṃtare tathā | vinyaseccaraṇaṃ dakṣaṃ svastikaṃ caitaducyate || 39 ||
verses.translation: Place the left foot between the right thigh and calf, and the right foot between the left thigh and calf: this is called the auspicious pose.
verses.hindi: बाएँ पैर को दाहिनी जाँघ और पिंडली के बीच, और दाहिने पैर को बाईं जाँघ और पिंडली के बीच रखे; इसे स्वस्तिकासन कहते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: दक्षिणोरुतले पादं वामं विन्यस्य दक्षिणम् । वामोरूपरि संयोज्यं वीरासनमितीरितम् ॥ ४० ॥
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇorutale pādaṃ vāmaṃ vinyasya dakṣiṇam | vāmorūpari saṃyojyaṃ vīrāsanamitīritam || 40 ||
verses.translation: Place the left foot under the right thigh and set the right foot over the left thigh: this is called the hero pose.
verses.hindi: बाएँ पैर को दाहिनी जाँघ के नीचे रखकर दाहिने पैर को बाईं जाँघ के ऊपर रखे; इसे वीरासन कहा गया है।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञेयं सर्वासनेष्वेतन्मुख्यं पीठचतुष्टयम् । साधकैरनिशं सेव्यं योगार्थिभिरतंद्रितैः ॥ ४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: jñeyaṃ sarvāsaneṣvetanmukhyaṃ pīṭhacatuṣṭayam | sādhakairaniśaṃ sevyaṃ yogārthibhirataṃdritaiḥ || 41 ||
verses.translation: Among all postures these four seats should be known as chief. Seekers of yoga should practise them constantly, without sloth.
verses.hindi: सब आसनों में इन चार आसनों को मुख्य जानना चाहिए। योग चाहने वाले साधक आलस्य छोड़कर इनका निरन्तर अभ्यास करें।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: स्थिरं स्यादासनं यस्य स योगं कर्तुमर्हति । शरीराचलताभावे नहि चित्तं स्थिरं भवेत् ॥ ४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sthiraṃ syādāsanaṃ yasya sa yogaṃ kartumarhati | śarīrācalatābhāve nahi cittaṃ sthiraṃ bhavet || 42 ||
verses.translation: Only one whose posture is steady is fit to practise yoga. If the body is not still, the mind does not become still.
verses.hindi: जिसका आसन स्थिर है, वही योग करने योग्य है। शरीर स्थिर न हो, तो मन भी स्थिर नहीं होता।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: आसनं त्वेकतानेन कृतं दुःखावहं भवेत् । शनैरभ्यासतस्तस्माद्वर्धयेदासने स्थितिम् ॥ ४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: āsanaṃ tvekatānena kṛtaṃ duḥkhāvahaṃ bhavet | śanairabhyāsatastasmādvardhayedāsane sthitim || 43 ||
verses.translation: A posture held all at once (for long) brings pain. So increase the time in the posture gradually, through practice.
verses.hindi: एक ही बार में (लम्बे समय तक) किया गया आसन कष्ट देता है। इसलिए धीरे-धीरे अभ्यास से आसन में बैठने का समय बढ़ाए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: यदा प्रहरपर्यंतं स्थिरं स्यादेकमासनम् । तदा योग्यं विजानीयादासनं योगसाधने ॥ ४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā praharaparyaṃtaṃ sthiraṃ syādekamāsanam | tadā yogyaṃ vijānīyādāsanaṃ yogasādhane || 44 ||
verses.translation: When one posture can be held steady for a watch (about three hours), know that posture to be fit for yoga practice.
verses.hindi: जब एक आसन एक प्रहर (लगभग तीन घण्टे) तक स्थिर रहने लगे, तब उस आसन को योग-साधना के योग्य समझे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: आसने स्थिरतां याते मनःस्थैर्यं भवेद्ध्रुवम् । प्राणस्यापि गतिर्नूनं शिथिला संप्रजायते ॥ ४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: āsane sthiratāṃ yāte manaḥsthairyaṃ bhaveddhruvam | prāṇasyāpi gatirnūnaṃ śithilā saṃprajāyate || 45 ||
verses.translation: When the posture becomes steady, the mind surely grows steady, and the movement of the breath certainly slows.
verses.hindi: आसन स्थिर होने पर मन निश्चय ही स्थिर होता है, और प्राण की गति भी अवश्य धीमी हो जाती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणां च चापल्यं शांतिमायाति निश्चितम् । ततो योगस्य सिद्धिः स्यात् तस्मादासनमभ्यसेत् ॥ ४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇāṃ ca cāpalyaṃ śāṃtimāyāti niścitam | tato yogasya siddhiḥ syāt tasmādāsanamabhyaset || 46 ||
verses.translation: The restlessness of the senses is surely calmed too. Then yoga succeeds; so practise posture.
verses.hindi: इन्द्रियों की चंचलता भी निश्चय ही शान्त हो जाती है। तब योग की सिद्धि होती है, इसलिए आसन का अभ्यास करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रमणं तीर्थयात्रासु नैव कार्यं हि योगिना । स्थित्वा स्थाने सदैकस्मिन् योगारंभं समाचरेत् ॥ ४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhramaṇaṃ tīrthayātrāsu naiva kāryaṃ hi yoginā | sthitvā sthāne sadaikasmin yogāraṃbhaṃ samācaret || 47 ||
verses.translation: A yogi should not wander on pilgrimages. Staying always in one place, he should begin yoga.
verses.hindi: योगी को तीर्थयात्राओं में घूमना नहीं चाहिए। एक ही स्थान पर सदा रहकर योग का आरम्भ करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायाममथेदानीं कथयामि समासतः । यस्य ज्ञानाद्भवेद्योगी योगसिद्धेस्तु भाजनम् ॥ ४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmamathedānīṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ | yasya jñānādbhavedyogī yogasiddhestu bhājanam || 48 ||
verses.translation: Now I shall briefly describe breath control, by knowing which a yogi becomes worthy of success in yoga.
verses.hindi: अब मैं संक्षेप में प्राणायाम का वर्णन करता हूँ, जिसे जानकर योगी योग की सिद्धि का पात्र बनता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणायामस्य भेदास्तु कथिता मुनिपुंगवैः । बहवो योगतंत्रेषु साधकानां हिताय वै ॥ ४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇāyāmasya bhedāstu kathitā munipuṃgavaiḥ | bahavo yogataṃtreṣu sādhakānāṃ hitāya vai || 49 ||
verses.translation: The great sages have described many kinds of breath control in the texts of yoga, for the good of seekers.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियों ने योग-ग्रन्थों में साधकों के हित के लिए प्राणायाम के बहुत से भेद बताए हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: द्वावेव तेषु सर्वेषु प्राणायामौ वरौ मतौ । चंद्रभेदनसंज्ञश्च भस्त्रिकासंज्ञकस्तथा ॥ ५० ॥
verses.transliteration: dvāveva teṣu sarveṣu prāṇāyāmau varau matau | caṃdrabhedanasaṃjñaśca bhastrikāsaṃjñakastathā || 50 ||
verses.translation: Of them all, two are held to be the best: moon-piercing and the bellows breath.
verses.hindi: उन सबमें दो ही प्राणायाम श्रेष्ठ माने गए हैं: चन्द्रभेदन और भस्त्रिका।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: संध्यादिकर्मवेलायां चंद्रभेदनमिष्यते । भस्त्रिका योगकाले स्यादिति ज्ञेयं विचक्षणैः ॥ ५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: saṃdhyādikarmavelāyāṃ caṃdrabhedanamiṣyate | bhastrikā yogakāle syāditi jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 51 ||
verses.translation: The wise should know that moon-piercing suits the time of the twilight rites and similar duties, and the bellows breath the time of yoga practice.
verses.hindi: सन्ध्या आदि कर्मों के समय चन्द्रभेदन उचित है, और योग-साधना के समय भस्त्रिका, ऐसा विद्वानों को जानना चाहिए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: वामनासिकया प्राणं पूरयेच्चंद्रमार्गतः । कुंभयित्वोदरे सम्यक् सूर्यद्वारेण रेचयेत् ॥ ५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: vāmanāsikayā prāṇaṃ pūrayeccaṃdramārgataḥ | kuṃbhayitvodare samyak sūryadvāreṇa recayet || 52 ||
verses.translation: Fill the breath through the left nostril, the path of the moon; hold it well in the belly, and release it through the gate of the sun (the right nostril).
verses.hindi: बाएँ नथुने से, चन्द्र-मार्ग से, प्राण को भरे; उसे पेट में भली-भाँति रोककर सूर्य-द्वार (दाहिने नथुने) से बाहर निकाले।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: पुनः पिंगलया पीत्वा कुंभयित्वा यथाबलम् । शनैर्विरेचयेत्प्राणं वामरंध्रेण युक्तितः ॥ ५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: punaḥ piṃgalayā pītvā kuṃbhayitvā yathābalam | śanairvirecayetprāṇaṃ vāmaraṃdhreṇa yuktitaḥ || 53 ||
verses.translation: Then draw breath through pingala (the right nostril), hold it as long as you can, and skilfully let it out slowly through the left nostril.
verses.hindi: फिर पिंगला (दाहिने नथुने) से साँस भरकर, शक्ति के अनुसार रोककर, युक्ति से बाएँ नथुने से धीरे-धीरे प्राण को निकाले।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवं वाथ गायत्रीं मनसा कुंभकावधि । जपेदेकांतगः सोयं चंद्रभेदनमुच्यते ॥ ५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: praṇavaṃ vātha gāyatrīṃ manasā kuṃbhakāvadhi | japedekāṃtagaḥ soyaṃ caṃdrabhedanamucyate || 54 ||
verses.translation: Seated alone, repeat Om or the Gayatri in the mind for the length of the retention. This is called moon-piercing.
verses.hindi: कुम्भक (साँस रोकने) तक मन में प्रणव या गायत्री का जप करे, एकान्त में बैठकर। इसे चन्द्रभेदन कहते हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: वामनासापुटात्प्राणं रेचयेत्तेन वै पिबेत् । पीतं विरेचयेत्तूर्णं दक्षनासापुटेन तम् ॥ ५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: vāmanāsāpuṭātprāṇaṃ recayettena vai pibet | pītaṃ virecayettūrṇaṃ dakṣanāsāpuṭena tam || 55 ||
verses.translation: Expel the breath through the left nostril and draw it in through the same; release what was drawn in at once through the right nostril.
verses.hindi: बाएँ नथुने से प्राण को बाहर निकाले और उसी से भीतर खींचे; खींची हुई साँस को तुरन्त दाहिने नथुने से निकाल दे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेनैव पीत्वाऽथ वामरंध्रेण रेचयेत् । वामेनैव ततः पीत्वा दक्षरंध्रेण रेचयेत् ॥ ५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatastenaiva pītvā'tha vāmaraṃdhreṇa recayet | vāmenaiva tataḥ pītvā dakṣaraṃdhreṇa recayet || 56 ||
verses.translation: Then draw in through that same (right) nostril and release through the left; then draw in through the left and release through the right.
verses.hindi: फिर उसी (दाहिने) से साँस भरकर बाएँ नथुने से निकाले; फिर बाएँ से ही भरकर दाहिने नथुने से निकाले।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: एवं पुनः पुनः कुर्याद्रेचपूरौ द्रुतं द्रुतम् । भस्त्रावल्लोहकारस्य क्षणमात्रं विचक्षणः ॥ ५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṃ punaḥ punaḥ kuryādrecapūrau drutaṃ drutam | bhastrāvallohakārasya kṣaṇamātraṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || 57 ||
verses.translation: In this way, again and again, the skilled practitioner should breathe out and in quickly, like a blacksmith's bellows, for a few moments.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार बार-बार, लोहार की धौंकनी की तरह, जल्दी-जल्दी साँस निकालना और भरना कुछ क्षण तक करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: ततो विरेचयेद्वायुं निखिलं वामरंध्रतः । किंचित्कालं बहीरुद्ध्वा वामेनैव पिबेत्ततः ॥ ५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato virecayedvāyuṃ nikhilaṃ vāmaraṃdhrataḥ | kiṃcitkālaṃ bahīruddhvā vāmenaiva pibettataḥ || 58 ||
verses.translation: Then expel all the air through the left nostril, hold it outside for a little while, and then draw breath in through the left.
verses.hindi: फिर बाएँ नथुने से सारी वायु निकाल दे, कुछ देर बाहर ही रोककर, फिर बाएँ से ही साँस भरे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: कुंभयेदुदरे पीतं प्राणं धृत्वा यथाबलम् । शनैर्विरेचयेत्पश्चाद् दक्षरंध्रेण बुद्धिमान् ॥ ५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: kuṃbhayedudare pītaṃ prāṇaṃ dhṛtvā yathābalam | śanairvirecayetpaścād dakṣaraṃdhreṇa buddhimān || 59 ||
verses.translation: Hold the inhaled breath in the belly as long as you can; afterwards the wise practitioner releases it slowly through the right nostril.
verses.hindi: भरी हुई प्राणवायु को शक्ति के अनुसार पेट में रोके, फिर बुद्धिमान साधक उसे दाहिने नथुने से धीरे-धीरे निकाले।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववद्भस्त्रिकां कृत्वा दक्षरंध्रेण रेचयेत् । किंचित्कालं बहीरुद्ध्वा ततस्तेनैव पूरयेत् ॥ ६० ॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvavadbhastrikāṃ kṛtvā dakṣaraṃdhreṇa recayet | kiṃcitkālaṃ bahīruddhvā tatastenaiva pūrayet || 60 ||
verses.translation: Do the bellows breath as before and release through the right nostril; hold it outside for a while, then fill through the same nostril.
verses.hindi: पहले की तरह भस्त्रिका करके दाहिने नथुने से (साँस) निकाले; कुछ देर बाहर रोककर फिर उसी से भरे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: कुंभयित्वा यथाशक्ति प्राणं वामेन रेचयेत् । वामदक्षक्रमेणैवं प्राणायामं समभ्यसेत् ॥ ६१ ॥
verses.transliteration: kuṃbhayitvā yathāśakti prāṇaṃ vāmena recayet | vāmadakṣakrameṇaivaṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ samabhyaset || 61 ||
verses.translation: Hold as long as you can and release the breath through the left. Practise breath control in this way, alternating left and right.
verses.hindi: शक्ति के अनुसार रोककर बाएँ नथुने से प्राण निकाले। इस प्रकार बाएँ और दाहिने के क्रम से प्राणायाम का अभ्यास करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: भस्त्रिकाकुंभकोऽयं स्याच्छीघ्रं प्राणजयप्रदः । कुंडलीचक्रभावघ्नस्त्रिदोषशमनः परः ॥ ६२ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhastrikākuṃbhako'yaṃ syācchīghraṃ prāṇajayapradaḥ | kuṃḍalīcakrabhāvaghnastridoṣaśamanaḥ paraḥ || 62 ||
verses.translation: This bellows retention quickly gives mastery over the breath, removes obstruction around kundalini and the chakras, and calms the three humours (wind, bile and phlegm).
verses.hindi: यह भस्त्रिका कुम्भक शीघ्र प्राण पर विजय देता है, कुण्डलिनी और चक्रों की रुकावट दूर करता है और तीनों दोषों (वात, पित्त, कफ) को शान्त करता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: अस्यैवांतर्भवंत्यन्ये प्राणायामा यतोऽखिलाः । तस्मादस्यैव कर्तव्यः सदाभ्यासः सुसाधकैः ॥ ६३ ॥
verses.transliteration: asyaivāṃtarbhavaṃtyanye prāṇāyāmā yato'khilāḥ | tasmādasyaiva kartavyaḥ sadābhyāsaḥ susādhakaiḥ || 63 ||
verses.translation: Since all the other breath controls are contained within this one, good practitioners should always practise it.
verses.hindi: क्योंकि दूसरे सब प्राणायाम इसी के भीतर आ जाते हैं, इसलिए अच्छे साधकों को सदा इसी का अभ्यास करना चाहिए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: कुंभकस्य तु मध्येऽपि पिबेद्वायुं विचक्षणः । एकवारं द्विवारं वा कुंभकस्य विवृद्धये ॥ ६४ ॥
verses.transliteration: kuṃbhakasya tu madhye'pi pibedvāyuṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | ekavāraṃ dvivāraṃ vā kuṃbhakasya vivṛddhaye || 64 ||
verses.translation: To lengthen the retention, a skilled practitioner may draw in air once or twice even in the middle of it.
verses.hindi: कुम्भक को बढ़ाने के लिए कुशल साधक कुम्भक के बीच में भी एक या दो बार वायु भीतर खींच सकता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: नाभौ संचिंतयेद्योगी सूर्यमंडलमुज्ज्वलम् । तेन प्राणनिरोधः स्याच्चिरकालं न संशयः ॥ ६५ ॥
verses.transliteration: nābhau saṃciṃtayedyogī sūryamaṃḍalamujjvalam | tena prāṇanirodhaḥ syāccirakālaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 65 ||
verses.translation: The yogi should picture a blazing disc of the sun at the navel. By this the breath is held for a long time, without doubt.
verses.hindi: योगी नाभि में उज्ज्वल सूर्य-मण्डल का ध्यान करे। इससे प्राण बहुत देर तक रुका रहता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: सायं प्रातश्च कुर्वीत प्राणायामं तु साधकः । घटिकात्रितयं नित्यं पथ्यपूर्वकमेकधीः ॥ ६६ ॥
verses.transliteration: sāyaṃ prātaśca kurvīta prāṇāyāmaṃ tu sādhakaḥ | ghaṭikātritayaṃ nityaṃ pathyapūrvakamekadhīḥ || 66 ||
verses.translation: The practitioner should practise breath control every evening and morning for three ghatikas (about seventy minutes), with single-minded attention, keeping to a proper diet.
verses.hindi: साधक नित्य सन्ध्या और प्रातः, पथ्य का पालन करते हुए, एकाग्र मन से तीन घड़ी (लगभग सवा घण्टा) प्राणायाम करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: रसमम्लं तथा क्षारं विदाहि कटुकं तथा । त्यक्त्वा भुंजीत गोधूमं मुद्गं वा तंडुलं तथा ॥ ६७ ॥
verses.transliteration: rasamamlaṃ tathā kṣāraṃ vidāhi kaṭukaṃ tathā | tyaktvā bhuṃjīta godhūmaṃ mudgaṃ vā taṃḍulaṃ tathā || 67 ||
verses.translation: Avoiding sour, salty, burning and pungent food, he should eat wheat, mung beans or rice.
verses.hindi: खट्टा, खारा, जलन करने वाला और कड़वा-तीखा भोजन छोड़कर गेहूँ, मूँग या चावल खाए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: घृतं नवीनं सेवेत निशायां च पयः पिबेत् । सैंधवं चाल्पमश्नीयात् तथैव मधुरं रसम् ॥ ६८ ॥
verses.transliteration: ghṛtaṃ navīnaṃ seveta niśāyāṃ ca payaḥ pibet | saiṃdhavaṃ cālpamaśnīyāt tathaiva madhuraṃ rasam || 68 ||
verses.translation: He should take fresh ghee, drink milk at night, and eat a little rock salt and sweet food.
verses.hindi: ताज़ा घी खाए, रात में दूध पिए, थोड़ा सेंधा नमक और मीठा रस ले।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: एतद्धि योगिनां पथ्यं नापथ्यं तु कदाचन । पथ्याभावे भवेद्योगी नानारोगसमन्वितः ॥ ६९ ॥
verses.transliteration: etaddhi yogināṃ pathyaṃ nāpathyaṃ tu kadācana | pathyābhāve bhavedyogī nānārogasamanvitaḥ || 69 ||
verses.translation: This is the right diet for yogis; never eat what is unsuitable. Without the right diet, a yogi falls prey to many diseases.
verses.hindi: यही योगियों का पथ्य है; कभी अपथ्य न करे। पथ्य न रखने पर योगी अनेक रोगों से घिर जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं मासद्वयं कुर्यात् त्रिमासं वा गतालसः । यावत्पंचशतं मात्राः कुंभकस्य भवंति हि ॥ ७० ॥
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ māsadvayaṃ kuryāt trimāsaṃ vā gatālasaḥ | yāvatpaṃcaśataṃ mātrāḥ kuṃbhakasya bhavaṃti hi || 70 ||
verses.translation: Free of sloth, he should practise like this for two or three months, until the retention reaches five hundred measures.
verses.hindi: आलस्य छोड़कर ऐसा दो या तीन महीने तक करे, जब तक कुम्भक पाँच सौ मात्राओं का न हो जाए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: एकादिगणनां कुर्यान्न द्रुतं न विलंबितम् । मनसा कुंभकाले तु मात्रास्ताः परिकीर्तिताः ॥ ७१ ॥
verses.transliteration: ekādigaṇanāṃ kuryānna drutaṃ na vilaṃbitam | manasā kuṃbhakāle tu mātrāstāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 71 ||
verses.translation: During retention he should count in the mind from one, neither too fast nor too slow: these are called the measures.
verses.hindi: कुम्भक के समय मन में एक से गिनती करे, न बहुत जल्दी और न बहुत धीरे; इन्हें मात्राएँ कहा गया है।

verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: मात्राणां तु भवेत्संख्या यदा पंचशताधिका । तदायोग्यं विजानीयात् कुंभकं शक्तिबोधने ॥ ७२ ॥
verses.transliteration: mātrāṇāṃ tu bhavetsaṃkhyā yadā paṃcaśatādhikā | tadāyogyaṃ vijānīyāt kuṃbhakaṃ śaktibodhane || 72 ||
verses.translation: When the count of measures passes five hundred, know the retention to be fit for awakening the power (kundalini).
verses.hindi: जब मात्राओं की संख्या पाँच सौ से अधिक हो जाए, तब कुम्भक को शक्ति (कुण्डलिनी) जगाने के योग्य समझे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: गतिं विज्ञाय नाडीनां कुंडलीस्थानमेव च । सम्यग्योगी ततो युक्त्या शक्तिबोधनमाचरेत् ॥ ७३ ॥
verses.transliteration: gatiṃ vijñāya nāḍīnāṃ kuṃḍalīsthānameva ca | samyagyogī tato yuktyā śaktibodhanamācaret || 73 ||
verses.translation: Having understood well the course of the channels and the seat of kundalini, the yogi should then skilfully awaken the power.
verses.hindi: नाड़ियों की गति और कुण्डलिनी के स्थान को भली-भाँति जानकर, फिर योगी युक्ति से शक्ति को जगाए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: अस्ति नाभेरधः कंदो देहमध्यगतः सदा । कुक्कुटांडसमाकारः सर्वनाडीसमाश्रयः ॥ ७४ ॥
verses.transliteration: asti nābheradhaḥ kaṃdo dehamadhyagataḥ sadā | kukkuṭāṃḍasamākāraḥ sarvanāḍīsamāśrayaḥ || 74 ||
verses.translation: Below the navel, in the middle of the body, there is a bulb shaped like a hen's egg, the base of all the channels.
verses.hindi: नाभि के नीचे, शरीर के मध्य में, मुर्गी के अण्डे के आकार का एक कन्द है, जो सब नाड़ियों का आश्रय है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादूर्ध्वमधस्तिर्यङ् निर्गताः सर्वनाडिकाः । देहं व्याप्यावतिष्ठंते भूमंडलमिवापगाः ॥ ७५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmādūrdhvamadhastiryaṅ nirgatāḥ sarvanāḍikāḥ | dehaṃ vyāpyāvatiṣṭhaṃte bhūmaṃḍalamivāpagāḥ || 75 ||
verses.translation: From it all the channels go out upwards, downwards and sideways, and spread through the body like rivers over the earth.
verses.hindi: उससे सब नाड़ियाँ ऊपर, नीचे और तिरछी निकलकर शरीर में वैसे ही फैली हैं जैसे पृथ्वी पर नदियाँ।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: तासु सर्वासु वै तिस्रः प्रधाना नाडिका मताः । इडा च पिंगला चैव सुषुम्नेति प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ ७६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tāsu sarvāsu vai tisraḥ pradhānā nāḍikā matāḥ | iḍā ca piṃgalā caiva suṣumneti prakīrtitāḥ || 76 ||
verses.translation: Among them all, three channels are held to be chief: ida, pingala and sushumna.
verses.hindi: उन सबमें तीन नाड़ियाँ प्रधान मानी गई हैं: इडा, पिंगला और सुषुम्ना।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: इडा वामे स्थिता नित्यं पिंगला दक्षिणे तथा । सुषुम्ना मध्यगा ज्ञेया योगसिद्धिप्रदायिनी ॥ ७७ ॥
verses.transliteration: iḍā vāme sthitā nityaṃ piṃgalā dakṣiṇe tathā | suṣumnā madhyagā jñeyā yogasiddhipradāyinī || 77 ||
verses.translation: Ida lies always on the left and pingala on the right. Sushumna runs in the middle, and it is she who grants success in yoga.
verses.hindi: इडा सदा बाईं ओर रहती है और पिंगला दाहिनी ओर। सुषुम्ना बीच में है, और वही योग की सिद्धि देती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: कंदमध्याद्विनिर्गत्य मेरुदंडेन संगता । सुषुम्ना पृष्ठमार्गेण ब्रह्मरंध्रमुपागता ॥ ७८ ॥
verses.transliteration: kaṃdamadhyādvinirgatya merudaṃḍena saṃgatā | suṣumnā pṛṣṭhamārgeṇa brahmaraṃdhramupāgatā || 78 ||
verses.translation: Sushumna rises from the middle of the bulb, joins the spine, and runs up the back to the opening of Brahman at the crown.
verses.hindi: सुषुम्ना कन्द के बीच से निकलकर मेरुदण्ड से जुड़ती है और पीठ के मार्ग से ब्रह्मरन्ध्र तक पहुँचती है।

verses.transliteration: tataścaiṣā parāvṛttyā bhrūkaṃṭhahṛdayādiṣu | kramāccakreṣu gacchaṃtī nābhimūlamupāśritā || 79 ||
verses.translation: Then, turning back, it passes in order through the centres at the brows, throat, heart and the rest, and rests at the root of the navel.
verses.hindi: फिर यह लौटकर भौंहों, कण्ठ, हृदय आदि के चक्रों से क्रम से होती हुई नाभि के मूल पर टिकती है।

verses.sanskrit: कंदोपरिगता नित्यं शक्तिः कुंडलिनी परा । सार्द्धत्रिवलयाकारा संसुप्तभुजगोपमा ॥ ८० ॥
verses.transliteration: kaṃdoparigatā nityaṃ śaktiḥ kuṃḍalinī parā | sārddhatrivalayākārā saṃsuptabhujagopamā || 80 ||
verses.translation: Above the bulb always lies the supreme power kundalini, coiled three and a half times, like a sleeping serpent.
verses.hindi: कन्द के ऊपर सदा परम शक्ति कुण्डलिनी रहती है, साढ़े तीन कुण्डल मारे, सोई हुई नागिन की तरह।

verses.sanskrit: सूक्ष्मा तडित्प्रतीकाशा जीवशक्तिसमाश्रया । मूलप्रकृतिरूपा सा सर्वप्राणिषु संगता ॥ ८१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sūkṣmā taḍitpratīkāśā jīvaśaktisamāśrayā | mūlaprakṛtirūpā sā sarvaprāṇiṣu saṃgatā || 81 ||
verses.translation: She is subtle, bright as lightning, the support of the life force; she is the form of primal nature and is present in all beings.
verses.hindi: वह सूक्ष्म है, बिजली जैसी चमकती है, जीव-शक्ति का आश्रय है; वह मूल प्रकृति का रूप है और सब प्राणियों में विद्यमान है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्याः प्राणस्तथापानो वहत्यूर्ध्वमधस्तथा । मध्ये सा बीजभूता तु संस्थिता परमेश्वरी ॥ ८२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāḥ prāṇastathāpāno vahatyūrdhvamadhastathā | madhye sā bījabhūtā tu saṃsthitā parameśvarī || 82 ||
verses.translation: Prana flows above her and apana below; between them she rests as the seed, the supreme goddess.
verses.hindi: उसके ऊपर प्राण बहता है और नीचे अपान; और बीच में वह परमेश्वरी बीज-रूप में स्थित है।

verses.sanskrit: येन मार्गेण गच्छंति प्राणा मूर्द्धनि योगिनः । मुखेनाच्छाद्य तद्द्वारं सुप्ता सा नागकन्यका ॥ ८३ ॥
verses.transliteration: yena mārgeṇa gacchaṃti prāṇā mūrddhani yoginaḥ | mukhenācchādya taddvāraṃ suptā sā nāgakanyakā || 83 ||
verses.translation: Covering with her mouth the gate by which a yogi's breaths go up to the head, that serpent maiden lies asleep.
verses.hindi: जिस मार्ग से योगी के प्राण सिर तक जाते हैं, उस द्वार को अपने मुख से ढककर वह नाग-कन्या सोई रहती है।

verses.sanskrit: यावत्सा निद्रिता देहे तावद्योगो न सिद्ध्यति । अतस्तद्बोधने युक्तिः सम्यगत्र निरूप्यते ॥ ८४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yāvatsā nidritā dehe tāvadyogo na siddhyati | atastadbodhane yuktiḥ samyagatra nirūpyate || 84 ||
verses.translation: As long as she sleeps in the body, yoga does not succeed. So the method of waking her is explained here in full.
verses.hindi: जब तक वह शरीर में सोई रहती है, तब तक योग सिद्ध नहीं होता। इसलिए यहाँ उसे जगाने की युक्ति भली-भाँति बताई जाती है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमो मूलबंधः स्यादुड्डियानो द्वितीयकः । जालंधरस्तृतीयश्च शक्तिबोधनहेतवः ॥ ८५ ॥
verses.transliteration: prathamo mūlabaṃdhaḥ syāduḍḍiyāno dvitīyakaḥ | jālaṃdharastṛtīyaśca śaktibodhanahetavaḥ || 85 ||
verses.translation: The first is the root lock, the second the upward-flying lock, and the third the throat lock; these are the means of waking the power.
verses.hindi: पहला मूलबन्ध है, दूसरा उड्डियान और तीसरा जालन्धर; ये शक्ति को जगाने के साधन हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धासने स्थितोऽपानं बलादूर्ध्वं विकर्षयेत् । आधाराकुंचनेनायं मूलबंधोऽभिधीयते ॥ ८६ ॥
verses.transliteration: siddhāsane sthito'pānaṃ balādūrdhvaṃ vikarṣayet | ādhārākuṃcanenāyaṃ mūlabaṃdho'bhidhīyate || 86 ||
verses.translation: Seated in the accomplished pose, draw apana forcefully upwards by contracting the base: this is called the root lock.
verses.hindi: सिद्धासन में बैठकर, गुदा को सिकोड़ते हुए अपान को बलपूर्वक ऊपर खींचे; इसे मूलबन्ध कहते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: नाभेः पश्चिमतानं हि बलात्कुर्यात्पुनः पुनः । उड्डियानो भवेद्बंधः प्राणोड्डयनकारकः ॥ ८७ ॥
verses.transliteration: nābheḥ paścimatānaṃ hi balātkuryātpunaḥ punaḥ | uḍḍiyāno bhavedbaṃdhaḥ prāṇoḍḍayanakārakaḥ || 87 ||
verses.translation: Draw the navel back (towards the spine) forcefully, again and again: this is the upward-flying lock, which makes the breath fly up.
verses.hindi: नाभि को बार-बार बलपूर्वक पीछे (रीढ़ की ओर) खींचे; यह उड्डियान बन्ध है, जो प्राण को ऊपर उड़ाता है।

verses.sanskrit: चिबुकं कंठकूपस्य न्यसेदुपरि भागतः । बंधो जालंधरः प्रोक्तः शिराजालनिरोधकः ॥ ८८ ॥
verses.transliteration: cibukaṃ kaṃṭhakūpasya nyasedupari bhāgataḥ | baṃdho jālaṃdharaḥ proktaḥ śirājālanirodhakaḥ || 88 ||
verses.translation: Place the chin over the hollow of the throat: this is called the throat lock, which closes the network of channels.
verses.hindi: ठोड़ी को कण्ठ के गड्ढे के ऊपर रखे; इसे जालन्धर बन्ध कहा गया है, जो नाड़ियों के जाल को रोकता है।

verses.sanskrit: बंधत्रयमिदं योगे योगिनामुपकारकम् । कुंडलीबोधकं शीघ्रं ब्रह्मरंध्रगतिप्रदम् ॥ ८९ ॥
verses.transliteration: baṃdhatrayamidaṃ yoge yogināmupakārakam | kuṃḍalībodhakaṃ śīghraṃ brahmaraṃdhragatipradam || 89 ||
verses.translation: These three locks help yogis in their practice; they quickly wake kundalini and open the way to the crown.
verses.hindi: ये तीनों बन्ध योग में योगियों के लिए सहायक हैं; ये कुण्डलिनी को शीघ्र जगाते हैं और ब्रह्मरन्ध्र तक गति देते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञात्वा बंधत्रयं योगी कुंडलीं बोधयेत्ततः । यस्याः प्रभेदाद्भिद्यंते चक्राणि ग्रंथयोऽपि च ॥ ९० ॥
verses.transliteration: jñātvā baṃdhatrayaṃ yogī kuṃḍalīṃ bodhayettataḥ | yasyāḥ prabhedādbhidyaṃte cakrāṇi graṃthayo'pi ca || 90 ||
verses.translation: Knowing the three locks, the yogi should then wake kundalini, by whose piercing the chakras and the knots are pierced too.
verses.hindi: तीनों बन्धों को जानकर योगी फिर कुण्डलिनी को जगाए, जिसके भेदन से चक्र और ग्रन्थियाँ भी भिद जाती हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववद्भस्त्रिकां कृत्वा रेचयेत्पवनं सुधीः । बहिरेवाथ तं रुद्ध्वा कुर्यादुड्डियानबंधनम् ॥ ९१ ॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvavadbhastrikāṃ kṛtvā recayetpavanaṃ sudhīḥ | bahirevātha taṃ ruddhvā kuryāduḍḍiyānabaṃdhanam || 91 ||
verses.translation: The wise practitioner should do the bellows breath as before and expel the air; then, holding it outside, apply the upward-flying lock.
verses.hindi: बुद्धिमान साधक पहले की तरह भस्त्रिका करके वायु निकाले; फिर उसे बाहर ही रोककर उड्डियान बन्ध लगाए।

verses.sanskrit: बलादपानमाकृष्य ततो वायुं प्रपूरयेत् । कुंभयित्वा यथाशक्ति शनैरेव विरेचयेत् ॥ ९२ ॥
verses.transliteration: balādapānamākṛṣya tato vāyuṃ prapūrayet | kuṃbhayitvā yathāśakti śanaireva virecayet || 92 ||
verses.translation: Then, drawing apana up forcefully, fill with air, hold as long as you can, and release slowly.
verses.hindi: फिर बलपूर्वक अपान को खींचकर वायु भरे, शक्ति के अनुसार रोके और धीरे-धीरे ही निकाले।

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धासने समासीनः सायं प्रातश्च साधकः । वामदक्षक्रमेणैवं मुहूर्त्तद्वयमभ्यसेत् ॥ ९३ ॥
verses.transliteration: siddhāsane samāsīnaḥ sāyaṃ prātaśca sādhakaḥ | vāmadakṣakrameṇaivaṃ muhūrttadvayamabhyaset || 93 ||
verses.translation: Seated in the accomplished pose, morning and evening, the practitioner should practise this for two muhurtas (about ninety minutes), alternating left and right.
verses.hindi: साधक सिद्धासन में बैठकर, सन्ध्या और प्रातः, बाएँ-दाहिने के क्रम से, दो मुहूर्त (लगभग डेढ़ घण्टा) यह अभ्यास करे।

verses.sanskrit: उड्डियाने कृते बंधे मूलबंधोऽपि जायते । तेनापानो व्रजेदूर्ध्वं प्राणस्य सदनं प्रति ॥ ९४ ॥
verses.transliteration: uḍḍiyāne kṛte baṃdhe mūlabaṃdho'pi jāyate | tenāpāno vrajedūrdhvaṃ prāṇasya sadanaṃ prati || 94 ||
verses.translation: When the upward-flying lock is applied, the root lock comes about too. By it apana rises towards the seat of prana.
verses.hindi: उड्डियान बन्ध लगाने पर मूलबन्ध भी अपने आप लग जाता है। उससे अपान ऊपर, प्राण के स्थान की ओर जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः कुंभकयोगेन प्राणोऽपानगृहं व्रजेत् । द्वयोः संघर्षणादग्निर्वर्धते देहमध्यगः ॥ ९५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kuṃbhakayogena prāṇo'pānagṛhaṃ vrajet | dvayoḥ saṃgharṣaṇādagnirvardhate dehamadhyagaḥ || 95 ||
verses.translation: Then, through retention, prana goes down to the home of apana. From the friction of the two the fire in the middle of the body grows.
verses.hindi: फिर कुम्भक से प्राण अपान के स्थान पर जाता है। दोनों के घर्षण से शरीर के मध्य की अग्नि बढ़ती है।

verses.transliteration: tato vahnipratāpena prāṇasaṃgharṣaṇena ca | daṃḍāhatā bhujaṃgīva kuṃḍalī saṃprabuddhyate || 96 ||
verses.translation: Then, by the heat of the fire and the friction of the breath, kundalini wakes up like a serpent struck with a stick.
verses.hindi: फिर अग्नि के ताप और प्राण के घर्षण से कुण्डलिनी वैसे ही जाग उठती है जैसे डण्डे से मारी गई नागिन।

verses.sanskrit: प्रबुद्धा सा जहात्याशु ब्रह्मरंध्रमुखं ध्रुवम् । सुषुम्नायां तदा प्राणो विशेदूर्ध्वं न संशयः ॥ ९७ ॥
verses.transliteration: prabuddhā sā jahātyāśu brahmaraṃdhramukhaṃ dhruvam | suṣumnāyāṃ tadā prāṇo viśedūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 97 ||
verses.translation: Once awake, she soon leaves the mouth of the passage to Brahman. Then the breath surely enters sushumna and rises.
verses.hindi: जागकर वह शीघ्र ही ब्रह्मरन्ध्र का मुख छोड़ देती है। तब प्राण निश्चय ही सुषुम्ना में ऊपर प्रवेश करता है।

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु हृदयांभोजे प्राणस्य गमनं भवेत् । वायोः संस्पर्शयोगेन ज्ञातव्यं साधकोत्तमैः ॥ ९८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tatastu hṛdayāṃbhoje prāṇasya gamanaṃ bhavet | vāyoḥ saṃsparśayogena jñātavyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ || 98 ||
verses.translation: Then the breath reaches the lotus of the heart. The best practitioners know this by the touch of the moving air.
verses.hindi: फिर प्राण हृदय-कमल तक पहुँचता है। श्रेष्ठ साधक इसे वायु के स्पर्श के अनुभव से जान लेते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: हृदयात्कंठमायाति कंठाद्भ्रूमध्यमेव च । भ्रूमध्याद्ब्रह्मरंध्रं च व्रजेत्प्राणः शनैःशनैः ॥ ९९ ॥
verses.transliteration: hṛdayātkaṃṭhamāyāti kaṃṭhādbhrūmadhyameva ca | bhrūmadhyādbrahmaraṃdhraṃ ca vrajetprāṇaḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 99 ||
verses.translation: Slowly the breath comes from the heart to the throat, from the throat to the point between the brows, and from there to the crown.
verses.hindi: प्राण धीरे-धीरे हृदय से कण्ठ में आता है, कण्ठ से भौंहों के बीच, और भौंहों के बीच से ब्रह्मरन्ध्र तक जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: यथायथैवापानस्य बलादाकर्षणं भवेत् । तथातथा भवेदूर्ध्वं शीघ्रं प्राणस्य रोहणम् ॥ १०० ॥
verses.transliteration: yathāyathaivāpānasya balādākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet | tathātathā bhavedūrdhvaṃ śīghraṃ prāṇasya rohaṇam || 100 ||
verses.translation: The more forcefully apana is drawn up, the faster the breath climbs upward.
verses.hindi: जितना-जितना अपान बलपूर्वक ऊपर खींचा जाता है, उतना-उतना प्राण शीघ्रता से ऊपर चढ़ता है।

chapters.title: Ojas-Tejas-Prana — The Three Vital Nectars
chapters.summary: Cultivation and preservation of vital stamina (ojas), cellular radiant intelligence (tejas), and pervasive life-energy (prana) through mindful conduct and yogic restraint.

verses.sanskrit: यदा चक्राणि भित्त्वासौ प्राणो मूर्धानमाव्रजेत् । तदा तत्रैव ध्यानेन स्थिरं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ॥ १०१ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā cakrāṇi bhittvāsau prāṇo mūrdhānamāvrajet | tadā tatraiva dhyānena sthiraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 101 ||
verses.translation: When the breath has pierced the chakras and reached the head, the skilled practitioner should make it steady right there through meditation.
verses.hindi: जब यह प्राण चक्रों को भेदकर सिर तक पहुँच जाए, तब कुशल साधक ध्यान के द्वारा उसे वहीं स्थिर करे।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्वमार्गमिमं प्राहुः सुषुम्नाया मुनीश्वराः । येन याता विमुच्यंते जन्मसंसारबंधनात् ॥ १०२ ॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvamārgamimaṃ prāhuḥ suṣumnāyā munīśvarāḥ | yena yātā vimucyaṃte janmasaṃsārabaṃdhanāt || 102 ||
verses.translation: The great sages call this the front path of sushumna; those who travel by it are freed from the bondage of birth and worldly life.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनि इसे सुषुम्ना का पूर्व (आगे का) मार्ग कहते हैं, जिससे जाने वाले जन्म और संसार के बन्धन से छूट जाते हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अथ पश्चिममार्गस्य भेदनं संनिरुच्यते । मेरुदंडं प्रविश्याशु येन प्राणः प्रलीयते ॥ १०३ ॥
verses.transliteration: atha paścimamārgasya bhedanaṃ saṃnirucyate | merudaṃḍaṃ praviśyāśu yena prāṇaḥ pralīyate || 103 ||
verses.translation: Now the piercing of the back path is described, by which the breath quickly enters the spine and dissolves there.
verses.hindi: अब पश्चिम (पीछे के) मार्ग के भेदन का वर्णन किया जाता है, जिससे प्राण शीघ्र मेरुदण्ड में प्रवेश करके लीन हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्ववद्भस्त्रिकां कृत्वा रेचयेदनिलं शनैः । रुद्ध्वा तं बहिरेवाशु कुर्यादुड्डियानबंधनम् ॥ १०४ ॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvavadbhastrikāṃ kṛtvā recayedanilaṃ śanaiḥ | ruddhvā taṃ bahirevāśu kuryāduḍḍiyānabaṃdhanam || 104 ||
verses.translation: Do the bellows breath as before and slowly let out the air; holding it outside, quickly apply the upward-flying lock.
verses.hindi: पहले की तरह भस्त्रिका करके धीरे-धीरे वायु निकाले; उसे बाहर ही रोककर शीघ्र उड्डियान बन्ध लगाए।

verses.sanskrit: नाभेः पश्चिमतानं तु तथा कुर्यात्प्रयत्नतः । यथा स्यान्मेरुदंडेन संलग्नं नाभिमंडलम् ॥ १०५ ॥
verses.transliteration: nābheḥ paścimatānaṃ tu tathā kuryātprayatnataḥ | yathā syānmerudaṃḍena saṃlagnaṃ nābhimaṃḍalam || 105 ||
verses.translation: Draw the navel back with effort, so far that the region of the navel presses against the spine.
verses.hindi: नाभि को प्रयत्नपूर्वक इतना पीछे खींचे कि नाभि-मण्डल मेरुदण्ड से सट जाए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: कृत्वाऽथ पूरकं शीघ्रं कुंभकं कारयेद्बुधः । मनसा चिंतयेच्चापि पृष्ठे प्राणस्य रोहणम् ॥ १०६ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā'tha pūrakaṃ śīghraṃ kuṃbhakaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | manasā ciṃtayeccāpi pṛṣṭhe prāṇasya rohaṇam || 106 ||
verses.translation: Then the wise practitioner should quickly breathe in and hold the breath, picturing in the mind the breath climbing up the back.
verses.hindi: फिर बुद्धिमान साधक शीघ्र पूरक (साँस भरना) करके कुम्भक करे, और मन में पीठ में प्राण के ऊपर चढ़ने का चिन्तन करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: दिनैः कतिपयैरेवमभ्यासं कुर्वतो ध्रुवम् । मेरुदंडे विशेत्प्राणो वंशरंध्रे यथानिलः ॥ १०७ ॥
verses.transliteration: dinaiḥ katipayairevamabhyāsaṃ kurvato dhruvam | merudaṃḍe viśetprāṇo vaṃśaraṃdhre yathānilaḥ || 107 ||
verses.translation: After practising like this for only a few days, the breath surely enters the spine as air enters the hollow of a bamboo.
verses.hindi: कुछ ही दिनों तक ऐसा अभ्यास करने पर प्राण निश्चय ही मेरुदण्ड में वैसे प्रवेश करता है जैसे बाँस के छेद में हवा।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: दिनानुदिनमभ्यासे क्रियमाणे यथाक्रमम् । ऊर्ध्वमूर्ध्वं व्रजेत्प्राणो भित्त्वा ग्रंथिसमुच्चयम् ॥ १०८ ॥
verses.transliteration: dinānudinamabhyāse kriyamāṇe yathākramam | ūrdhvamūrdhvaṃ vrajetprāṇo bhittvā graṃthisamuccayam || 108 ||
verses.translation: As the practice goes on day after day in due order, the breath pierces the cluster of knots and rises higher and higher.
verses.hindi: दिन-प्रतिदिन क्रम से अभ्यास करते रहने पर प्राण ग्रन्थियों के समूह को भेदकर ऊपर-ऊपर जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अंगे पिपीलिकारोहे यथा स्पर्शः प्रतीयते । मेरुदंडे तथा वायोः स्पर्शः स्यादूर्ध्वरोहणे ॥ १०९ ॥
verses.transliteration: aṃge pipīlikārohe yathā sparśaḥ pratīyate | merudaṃḍe tathā vāyoḥ sparśaḥ syādūrdhvarohaṇe || 109 ||
verses.translation: Just as one feels an ant climbing on the body, so one feels the touch of the air in the spine as it climbs.
verses.hindi: जैसे शरीर पर चींटी चढ़ने का स्पर्श अनुभव होता है, वैसे ही ऊपर चढ़ते समय मेरुदण्ड में वायु का स्पर्श अनुभव होता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मरंध्रं व्रजेत्प्राणो यदा पश्चिममार्गतः । पूरयेत्तत्र तं नित्यं संतताभ्यासयोगतः ॥ ११० ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmaraṃdhraṃ vrajetprāṇo yadā paścimamārgataḥ | pūrayettatra taṃ nityaṃ saṃtatābhyāsayogataḥ || 110 ||
verses.translation: When the breath has reached the crown by the back path, keep filling it there every day through unbroken practice.
verses.hindi: जब प्राण पश्चिम मार्ग से ब्रह्मरन्ध्र तक पहुँच जाए, तब निरन्तर अभ्यास से उसे नित्य वहीं भरता रहे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: तदा भस्त्रां परित्यज्य कुर्यात्कुंभं तु केवलम् । यथा स्यात्प्राणसंचारो विशेषात्पश्चिमे पथि ॥ १११ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadā bhastrāṃ parityajya kuryātkuṃbhaṃ tu kevalam | yathā syātprāṇasaṃcāro viśeṣātpaścime pathi || 111 ||
verses.translation: Then give up the bellows breath and practise retention alone, so that the breath moves especially along the back path.
verses.hindi: तब भस्त्रिका छोड़कर केवल कुम्भक करे, जिससे प्राण का संचार विशेष रूप से पश्चिम मार्ग में हो।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: वर्द्धमाने ततोऽभ्यासे प्राणस्त्यक्त्वा गमागमौ । ब्रह्मरंध्रे लयं याति मनश्चानु विलीयते ॥ ११२ ॥
verses.transliteration: varddhamāne tato'bhyāse prāṇastyaktvā gamāgamau | brahmaraṃdhre layaṃ yāti manaścānu vilīyate || 112 ||
verses.translation: Then, as practice grows, the breath stops coming and going and dissolves at the crown, and the mind dissolves after it.
verses.hindi: फिर अभ्यास बढ़ने पर प्राण आना-जाना छोड़कर ब्रह्मरन्ध्र में लीन हो जाता है, और उसके पीछे मन भी लीन हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: प्राणे मूर्धनि संप्राप्ते नादध्वनिरनुत्तमः । श्रूयते योगिनो वक्रे संस्रवेदमृतं तथा ॥ ११३ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇe mūrdhani saṃprāpte nādadhvaniranuttamaḥ | śrūyate yogino vakre saṃsravedamṛtaṃ tathā || 113 ||
verses.translation: When the breath reaches the head, the yogi hears a matchless inner sound, and nectar trickles into his mouth.
verses.hindi: प्राण के सिर में पहुँचने पर योगी को अनुपम नाद की ध्वनि सुनाई देती है, और उसके मुख में अमृत भी टपकता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: आनंदानुभवस्तत्र जायते योगिनो महान् । स एव तं विजानाति मया वक्तुं न शक्यते ॥ ११४ ॥
verses.transliteration: ānaṃdānubhavastatra jāyate yogino mahān | sa eva taṃ vijānāti mayā vaktuṃ na śakyate || 114 ||
verses.translation: There the yogi has a great experience of bliss. Only he knows it; I cannot describe it.
verses.hindi: वहाँ योगी को आनन्द का महान अनुभव होता है। उसे वही जानता है; मैं उसका वर्णन नहीं कर सकता।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: नैव तं विषयासक्ता विदुर्नो शास्त्रचिंतकाः । योगजं परमानंदं योगिनोऽनुभवंति यम् ॥ ११५ ॥
verses.transliteration: naiva taṃ viṣayāsaktā vidurno śāstraciṃtakāḥ | yogajaṃ paramānaṃdaṃ yogino'nubhavaṃti yam || 115 ||
verses.translation: The supreme bliss born of yoga that yogis experience is known neither to those attached to pleasures nor to those who only ponder texts.
verses.hindi: योग से उत्पन्न जिस परम आनन्द का अनुभव योगी करते हैं, उसे न विषयों में आसक्त लोग जानते हैं, न केवल शास्त्र पर विचार करने वाले।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: मुहूर्तार्धं मुहूर्तं वा स्थित्वा मूर्धनि योगवित् । ततोऽवतारयेत्प्राणं सुषुम्नापूर्वमार्गतः ॥ ११६ ॥
verses.transliteration: muhūrtārdhaṃ muhūrtaṃ vā sthitvā mūrdhani yogavit | tato'vatārayetprāṇaṃ suṣumnāpūrvamārgataḥ || 116 ||
verses.translation: After staying in the head for half a muhurta or a full muhurta, the knower of yoga should bring the breath down by the front path of sushumna.
verses.hindi: योग को जानने वाला आधा मुहूर्त या एक मुहूर्त सिर में ठहरकर, फिर सुषुम्ना के पूर्व मार्ग से प्राण को नीचे उतारे।

verses.sanskrit: स्थापयेच्च यथास्थानं स्वदेहे तं विचक्षणः । शनैरेव समुत्थाय विश्रांतोऽथ सुखं चरेत् ॥ ११७ ॥
verses.transliteration: sthāpayecca yathāsthānaṃ svadehe taṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ | śanaireva samutthāya viśrāṃto'tha sukhaṃ caret || 117 ||
verses.translation: The skilled practitioner should settle it back in its place in the body, then rise slowly, rest, and go about at ease.
verses.hindi: कुशल साधक उसे अपने शरीर में यथास्थान स्थापित करे, फिर धीरे-धीरे उठकर, विश्राम करके सुख से विचरे।

verses.sanskrit: कुंभकाभ्यासतो नित्यं ध्यानयोगाच्च मूर्धनि । स्थितिं संवर्धयेद्योगी समाधिः स्याद्यथा चिरम् ॥ ११८ ॥
verses.transliteration: kuṃbhakābhyāsato nityaṃ dhyānayogācca mūrdhani | sthitiṃ saṃvardhayedyogī samādhiḥ syādyathā ciram || 118 ||
verses.translation: Through daily practice of retention and meditation, the yogi should lengthen the breath's stay in the head, so that absorption lasts long.
verses.hindi: नित्य कुम्भक के अभ्यास और ध्यान-योग से योगी सिर में (प्राण की) स्थिति बढ़ाए, जिससे समाधि देर तक रहे।
