verses.sanskrit: प्राणस्य त्वखिलं कर्म मनोयुक्तं समभ्यसेत् । मनसो विकलीभावे प्राणो न स्थिरतां व्रजेत् ॥ ११९ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇasya tvakhilaṃ karma manoyuktaṃ samabhyaset | manaso vikalībhāve prāṇo na sthiratāṃ vrajet || 119 ||
verses.translation: Every practice of the breath should be done with the mind joined to it. If the mind is unsettled, the breath does not grow steady.
verses.hindi: प्राण का सारा कर्म मन को साथ जोड़कर ही करे। मन विचलित हो तो प्राण स्थिर नहीं होता।

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्याहारमथो वक्ष्ये यथोक्तं मुनिपुंगवैः । साधनाद्यस्य योगीन्द्रो निर्विघ्नं सिद्धिमृच्छति ॥ १२० ॥
verses.transliteration: pratyāhāramatho vakṣye yathoktaṃ munipuṃgavaiḥ | sādhanādyasya yogīndro nirvighnaṃ siddhimṛcchati || 120 ||
verses.translation: Now I shall describe withdrawal of the senses as the great sages taught it, by practising which the master yogi gains success without obstacles.
verses.hindi: अब मैं प्रत्याहार का वर्णन करूँगा, जैसा श्रेष्ठ मुनियों ने कहा है, जिसकी साधना से योगी बिना विघ्न के सिद्धि पाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाणि चरंतीह विषयेषु स्वभावतः । यत्नादाहरणं तेषां प्रत्याहारो निगद्यते ॥ १२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇi caraṃtīha viṣayeṣu svabhāvataḥ | yatnādāharaṇaṃ teṣāṃ pratyāhāro nigadyate || 121 ||
verses.translation: Here the senses by their nature roam among their objects. Drawing them back with effort is called withdrawal.
verses.hindi: यहाँ इन्द्रियाँ स्वभाव से ही विषयों में घूमती हैं। प्रयत्न से उन्हें वहाँ से वापस खींचना प्रत्याहार कहलाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रियाण्यवशीकृत्य यस्तु योगं समभ्यसेत् । भिन्नभांडांबुवत्तस्य योगः क्षरति संततम् ॥ १२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: indriyāṇyavaśīkṛtya yastu yogaṃ samabhyaset | bhinnabhāṃḍāṃbuvattasya yogaḥ kṣarati saṃtatam || 122 ||
verses.translation: If someone practises yoga without bringing the senses under control, his yoga keeps leaking away like water from a cracked pot.
verses.hindi: जो इन्द्रियों को वश में किए बिना योग का अभ्यास करता है, उसका योग टूटे घड़े के पानी की तरह लगातार रिसता रहता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: विषयेषु समासक्तो न योगं कर्तुमर्हति । तस्माद्विषयसंत्यागो योगिनां परमो हितः ॥ १२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: viṣayeṣu samāsakto na yogaṃ kartumarhati | tasmādviṣayasaṃtyāgo yogināṃ paramo hitaḥ || 123 ||
verses.translation: One attached to pleasures is not fit to practise yoga. So giving up pleasures is of the highest good to yogis.
verses.hindi: जो विषयों में आसक्त है, वह योग करने योग्य नहीं। इसलिए विषयों का त्याग योगियों के लिए परम हितकारी है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वमनाहृत्य योगोपकरणं विना । निःसंगो निर्जनस्थाने योगमेव सदाऽभ्यसेत् ॥ १३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvamanāhṛtya yogopakaraṇaṃ vinā | niḥsaṃgo nirjanasthāne yogameva sadā'bhyaset || 131 ||
verses.translation: So, gathering nothing beyond what yoga needs, free of company, one should always practise yoga alone in a solitary place.
verses.hindi: इसलिए योग के साधनों के सिवा कुछ भी इकट्ठा न करके, संग छोड़कर, निर्जन स्थान में सदा योग का ही अभ्यास करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: शब्दादिविषया लोके सुलभाः सर्वयोनिषु । दुर्लभं मानुषं देहं मत्वाऽऽसक्तिं न कारयेत् ॥ १३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: śabdādiviṣayā loke sulabhāḥ sarvayoniṣu | durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ matvā''saktiṃ na kārayet || 132 ||
verses.translation: Sound and the other pleasures are easy to find in every kind of birth in the world; but a human body is rare. Knowing this, do not become attached to them.
verses.hindi: शब्द आदि विषय संसार में सब योनियों में सरलता से मिल जाते हैं; पर मनुष्य-देह दुर्लभ है, यह मानकर (विषयों में) आसक्ति न करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: घृतासेकाद्यथा वह्नेर्ज्वाला भूयोऽभिवर्धते । विषयासेवनाज्जंतोस्तथा तृष्णाभिवर्धते ॥ १३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: ghṛtāsekādyathā vahnerjvālā bhūyo'bhivardhate | viṣayāsevanājjaṃtostathā tṛṣṇābhivardhate || 133 ||
verses.translation: Just as a flame grows higher when ghee is poured on it, so a creature's craving grows when it indulges in pleasures.
verses.hindi: जैसे घी डालने से आग की लपट और बढ़ती है, वैसे ही विषयों के भोग से प्राणी की तृष्णा और बढ़ती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: जितं तेन जगत्सर्वं येनेन्द्रियगणो जितः । इन्द्रियाणां वशो यस्मादेतद्विश्वमशेषतः ॥ १३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: jitaṃ tena jagatsarvaṃ yenendriyagaṇo jitaḥ | indriyāṇāṃ vaśo yasmādetadviśvamaśeṣataḥ || 134 ||
verses.translation: Whoever has conquered the senses has conquered the whole world, for this entire universe is in the grip of the senses.
verses.hindi: जिसने इन्द्रियों के समूह को जीत लिया, उसने सारा जगत् जीत लिया, क्योंकि यह सारा विश्व इन्द्रियों के ही वश में है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: जितेन्द्रियस्य चेतस्तु स्वतः शांतं प्रजायते । तेन सिद्धिर्हि योगस्य शीघ्रं भवति निश्चितम् ॥ १३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: jitendriyasya cetastu svataḥ śāṃtaṃ prajāyate | tena siddhirhi yogasya śīghraṃ bhavati niścitam || 135 ||
verses.translation: The mind of one who has mastered the senses becomes calm of itself, and through that, success in yoga surely comes quickly.
verses.hindi: जितेन्द्रिय का चित्त अपने आप शान्त हो जाता है, और उससे योग की सिद्धि निश्चय ही शीघ्र होती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादिन्द्रियवर्गस्य प्रत्याहारं प्रयत्नतः । कृत्वा धीरमना योगी भवेदभ्यासतत्परः ॥ १३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmādindriyavargasya pratyāhāraṃ prayatnataḥ | kṛtvā dhīramanā yogī bhavedabhyāsatatparaḥ || 136 ||
verses.translation: So, having withdrawn the senses with effort, the yogi of steady mind should remain devoted to practice.
verses.hindi: इसलिए प्रयत्नपूर्वक इन्द्रियों का प्रत्याहार करके, धीर मन वाला योगी अभ्यास में लगा रहे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: धारणायाः स्वरूपं तु सम्यगत्र निरूप्यते । यस्यास्त्वभ्यासतो योगी सर्वसिद्धीश्वरो भवेत् ॥ १३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhāraṇāyāḥ svarūpaṃ tu samyagatra nirūpyate | yasyāstvabhyāsato yogī sarvasiddhīśvaro bhavet || 137 ||
verses.translation: Now the nature of concentration is explained here in full, by practising which a yogi becomes master of every power.
verses.hindi: अब यहाँ धारणा का स्वरूप भली-भाँति बताया जाता है, जिसके अभ्यास से योगी सब सिद्धियों का स्वामी बन जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वतो विनियम्यैकदेशे चित्तस्य बंधनम् । पुनः पुनः प्रयत्नेन धारणा सा निगद्यते ॥ १३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvato viniyamyaikadeśe cittasya baṃdhanam | punaḥ punaḥ prayatnena dhāraṇā sā nigadyate || 138 ||
verses.translation: Holding the mind back from everything and binding it to one place, again and again with effort, is called concentration.
verses.hindi: चित्त को सब ओर से रोककर बार-बार प्रयत्न से एक स्थान पर बाँधना धारणा कहलाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: देशा बहुविधाः प्रोक्ता धारणाया मुनीश्वरैः । स्वशरीरे तथा बाह्यपदार्थेषु यथारुचि ॥ १३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: deśā bahuvidhāḥ proktā dhāraṇāyā munīśvaraiḥ | svaśarīre tathā bāhyapadārtheṣu yathāruci || 139 ||
verses.translation: The great sages describe many places for concentration, both in one's own body and in outer things, as one prefers.
verses.hindi: श्रेष्ठ मुनियों ने धारणा के अनेक स्थान बताए हैं, अपने शरीर में भी और बाहर की वस्तुओं में भी, अपनी रुचि के अनुसार।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रुवोर्मध्ये च नासाग्रे नाभौ वा हृदयांबुजे । शरीरे धारणां कुर्यादेकांते सुसमाहितः ॥ १४० ॥
verses.transliteration: bhruvormadhye ca nāsāgre nābhau vā hṛdayāṃbuje | śarīre dhāraṇāṃ kuryādekāṃte susamāhitaḥ || 140 ||
verses.translation: Alone and well collected, one may concentrate within the body: between the brows, at the tip of the nose, at the navel, or on the lotus of the heart.
verses.hindi: एकान्त में भली-भाँति एकाग्र होकर भौंहों के बीच, नाक के अगले भाग पर, नाभि में या हृदय-कमल में, शरीर में धारणा करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: चंद्रे ध्रुवादितारासु गिरिशृंगेऽथवा तरौ । देवताप्रतिमायां वा बहिश्चित्तं विधारयेत् ॥ १४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: caṃdre dhruvāditārāsu giriśṛṃge'thavā tarau | devatāpratimāyāṃ vā bahiścittaṃ vidhārayet || 141 ||
verses.translation: Or one may fix the mind outside: on the moon, on the pole star and other stars, on a mountain peak, on a tree, or on the image of a deity.
verses.hindi: या बाहर चन्द्रमा पर, ध्रुव आदि तारों पर, पर्वत की चोटी पर, किसी वृक्ष पर, या देवता की प्रतिमा पर चित्त को टिकाए।

verses.sanskrit: धारणां कुर्वतश्चित्तं चलं गच्छेद्यतो यतः । ततस्ततो नियम्याशु धारणादेशमानयेत् ॥ १४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhāraṇāṃ kurvataścittaṃ calaṃ gacchedyato yataḥ | tatastato niyamyāśu dhāraṇādeśamānayet || 142 ||
verses.translation: Wherever the restless mind wanders during concentration, rein it in from there and quickly bring it back to the place of concentration.
verses.hindi: धारणा करते हुए चंचल चित्त जहाँ-जहाँ जाए, वहाँ-वहाँ से उसे रोककर शीघ्र धारणा के स्थान पर ले आए।

verses.sanskrit: यततो योगिनश्चैवं यदा स्याद्धारणा दृढा । कर्मबंधाद्विनिर्मुक्तो भवेत्सिद्धस्तदा ध्रुवम् ॥ १४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: yatato yoginaścaivaṃ yadā syāddhāraṇā dṛḍhā | karmabaṃdhādvinirmukto bhavetsiddhastadā dhruvam || 143 ||
verses.translation: When, striving like this, the yogi's concentration becomes firm, he is freed from the bondage of karma and surely becomes accomplished.
verses.hindi: ऐसा प्रयत्न करते हुए योगी की धारणा जब दृढ़ हो जाती है, तब वह कर्म के बन्धन से छूटकर निश्चय ही सिद्ध हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: नासाग्रे हृदयाम्भोजे भ्रूमध्ये च विशेषतः । कुर्वाणो धारणां योगी ज्योतिः पश्यति चिन्मयम् ॥ १४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: nāsāgre hṛdayāmbhoje bhrūmadhye ca viśeṣataḥ | kurvāṇo dhāraṇāṃ yogī jyotiḥ paśyati cinmayam || 144 ||
verses.translation: Concentrating on the tip of the nose, on the lotus of the heart, and above all between the brows, the yogi sees a light made of consciousness.
verses.hindi: नाक के अगले भाग पर, हृदय-कमल में और विशेष रूप से भौंहों के बीच धारणा करते हुए योगी चेतना-स्वरूप ज्योति को देखता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: नाभिचक्रे यदा कुर्याद्धारणां योगविद्यदि । शरीराभ्यन्तरे सर्वं संस्थानं तु विलोकयेत् ॥ १४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: nābhicakre yadā kuryāddhāraṇāṃ yogavidyadi | śarīrābhyantare sarvaṃ saṃsthānaṃ tu vilokayet || 145 ||
verses.translation: If the knower of yoga concentrates on the navel centre, he sees the whole structure inside the body.
verses.hindi: योग को जानने वाला यदि नाभि-चक्र पर धारणा करे, तो वह शरीर के भीतर की सारी रचना को देख लेता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु धारयेद्योगी चित्तमादित्यमंडले । तस्य सर्वं भवेन्नूनं त्रैलोक्यं दृष्टिगोचरम् ॥ १४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā tu dhārayedyogī cittamādityamaṃḍale | tasya sarvaṃ bhavennūnaṃ trailokyaṃ dṛṣṭigocaram || 146 ||
verses.translation: When the yogi fixes his mind on the disc of the sun, all three worlds surely come within his sight.
verses.hindi: जब योगी चित्त को सूर्य-मण्डल पर टिकाता है, तब निश्चय ही तीनों लोक उसकी दृष्टि में आ जाते हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: धारणां कुर्वतश्चंद्रमंडले योगिनोऽखिलम् । नक्षत्राणामवस्थानं क्षिप्रं प्रत्यक्षतामियात् ॥ १४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhāraṇāṃ kurvataścaṃdramaṃḍale yogino'khilam | nakṣatrāṇāmavasthānaṃ kṣipraṃ pratyakṣatāmiyāt || 147 ||
verses.translation: For a yogi who concentrates on the disc of the moon, the whole arrangement of the constellations soon becomes plain to see.
verses.hindi: चन्द्र-मण्डल पर धारणा करने वाले योगी के सामने नक्षत्रों की सारी स्थिति शीघ्र प्रत्यक्ष हो जाती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: तारकाणां गतिं सर्वां ध्रुवे कुर्वँस्तु धारणाम् । सम्यग्योगी विजानीयाच्चिरं स्थिरमानसः ॥ १४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tārakāṇāṃ gatiṃ sarvāṃ dhruve kurva~stu dhāraṇām | samyagyogī vijānīyācciraṃ sthiramānasaḥ || 148 ||
verses.translation: Concentrating on the pole star, a yogi of steady mind comes in time to know fully all the movements of the stars.
verses.hindi: ध्रुव तारे पर धारणा करते हुए, स्थिर मन वाला योगी समय के साथ तारों की सारी गति भली-भाँति जान लेता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: वृक्षाग्रे पर्वताग्रे वा धारणां कुर्वतः सदा । भवेदाकाशगामित्वं सूक्ष्मदेहेन योगिनः ॥ १४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣāgre parvatāgre vā dhāraṇāṃ kurvataḥ sadā | bhavedākāśagāmitvaṃ sūkṣmadehena yoginaḥ || 149 ||
verses.translation: A yogi who always concentrates on the top of a tree or a mountain peak gains the power to move through the sky in a subtle body.
verses.hindi: वृक्ष की चोटी या पर्वत की चोटी पर सदा धारणा करने वाला योगी सूक्ष्म देह से आकाश में चलने लगता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिव्यां धारणां कृत्वा योगी तन्मयतां गतः । निधिं पश्यति दूरस्थं पातालं स्वेच्छया व्रजेत् ॥ १५० ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṃ dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā yogī tanmayatāṃ gataḥ | nidhiṃ paśyati dūrasthaṃ pātālaṃ svecchayā vrajet || 150 ||
verses.translation: Concentrating on earth and becoming one with it, the yogi sees treasure far away and can go down to the netherworld at will.
verses.hindi: पृथ्वी पर धारणा करके उसमें तन्मय हुआ योगी दूर स्थित खज़ाने को देख लेता है और अपनी इच्छा से पाताल तक जा सकता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: जले जलमयीं कुर्याद्धारणां योगविद्यदि । जलस्तंभो भवेत्तस्य मीनवत्सलिले चरेत् ॥ १५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: jale jalamayīṃ kuryāddhāraṇāṃ yogavidyadi | jalastaṃbho bhavettasya mīnavatsalile caret || 151 ||
verses.translation: If the knower of yoga practises concentration on water, becoming one with it, he can still water and moves in it like a fish.
verses.hindi: योग को जानने वाला यदि जल में जलमयी धारणा करे, तो वह जल को रोक सकता है और मछली की तरह जल में विचरता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: वह्निधारणया योगी नाग्निना दह्यते क्वचित् । स्वदेहमथवा दग्ध्वा सूक्ष्मदेहेन वै चरेत् ॥ १५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: vahnidhāraṇayā yogī nāgninā dahyate kvacit | svadehamathavā dagdhvā sūkṣmadehena vai caret || 152 ||
verses.translation: Through concentration on fire, a yogi is never burned by fire; or he may burn up his own body and move about in a subtle one.
verses.hindi: अग्नि की धारणा से योगी कभी अग्नि से नहीं जलता; या वह अपनी देह को जलाकर सूक्ष्म देह से विचरता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: वायुधारणया योगी वायुवद्व्योमगो भवेत् । सूक्ष्मरंध्रेषु सर्वत्र प्रविशेदविरोधतः ॥ १५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: vāyudhāraṇayā yogī vāyuvadvyomago bhavet | sūkṣmaraṃdhreṣu sarvatra praviśedavirodhataḥ || 153 ||
verses.translation: Through concentration on air, a yogi moves through the sky like the wind and can enter the finest openings anywhere without hindrance.
verses.hindi: वायु की धारणा से योगी वायु की तरह आकाश में चलने वाला हो जाता है और बिना रुकावट हर जगह सूक्ष्म छिद्रों में प्रवेश कर सकता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: व्योमधारणया तद्वद्व्योमवद्व्यापको भवेत् । सर्वमात्मन्यवेक्षेत जगदेतच्चराचरम् ॥ १५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: vyomadhāraṇayā tadvadvyomavadvyāpako bhavet | sarvamātmanyavekṣeta jagadetaccarācaram || 154 ||
verses.translation: In the same way, through concentration on space, he becomes all-pervading like space and sees this whole world, moving and unmoving, within himself.
verses.hindi: उसी प्रकार आकाश की धारणा से वह आकाश की तरह सर्वव्यापी हो जाता है और इस सारे चर-अचर जगत् को अपने भीतर देखता है।

verses.sanskrit: विषया धारणायास्तु सत्यन्येपि सहस्रशः । स्वयंबुद्ध्या विजानीयाद्यथाकार्यं यथाक्रमम् ॥ १५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: viṣayā dhāraṇāyāstu satyanyepi sahasraśaḥ | svayaṃbuddhyā vijānīyādyathākāryaṃ yathākramam || 155 ||
verses.translation: There are thousands of other objects for concentration too. One should work them out with one's own judgement, as needed and in due order.
verses.hindi: धारणा के हजारों और विषय भी हैं। उन्हें अपनी बुद्धि से, आवश्यकता और क्रम के अनुसार जान लेना चाहिए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: योगिनां क्षीणपापानां नित्यमेकांतवासिनाम् । युक्ताहारविहाराणां सिद्धा भवति धारणा ॥ १५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: yogināṃ kṣīṇapāpānāṃ nityamekāṃtavāsinām | yuktāhāravihārāṇāṃ siddhā bhavati dhāraṇā || 156 ||
verses.translation: Concentration succeeds for yogis whose sins are worn away, who always live in solitude, and whose eating and habits are measured.
verses.hindi: जिन योगियों के पाप नष्ट हो गए हैं, जो सदा एकान्त में रहते हैं और जिनका आहार-विहार संयमित है, उनकी धारणा सिद्ध होती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अथ ध्यानं प्रवक्ष्यामि मुक्तिसाधनमुत्तमम् । यत्कृत्वा न पुनर्जंतुर्जातु मातुः स्तनं पिबेत् ॥ १५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: atha dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi muktisādhanamuttamam | yatkṛtvā na punarjaṃturjātu mātuḥ stanaṃ pibet || 157 ||
verses.translation: Now I shall describe meditation, the best means to liberation; having practised it, a creature never again drinks at a mother's breast.
verses.hindi: अब मैं ध्यान का वर्णन करूँगा, जो मुक्ति का उत्तम साधन है, जिसे करके प्राणी फिर कभी माता का स्तन नहीं पीता (फिर जन्म नहीं लेता)।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: सगुणं निर्गुणं चैव द्विधा ध्यानं प्रकीर्तितम् । सगुणं व्यक्तियुक्तं स्याद्व्यक्तं निर्गुणं भवेत् ॥ १५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ caiva dvidhā dhyānaṃ prakīrtitam | saguṇaṃ vyaktiyuktaṃ syādvyaktaṃ nirguṇaṃ bhavet || 158 ||
verses.translation: Meditation is said to be of two kinds: with attributes and without. Meditation with attributes has a form; meditation without attributes is formless.
verses.hindi: ध्यान दो प्रकार का कहा गया है: सगुण और निर्गुण। सगुण ध्यान किसी रूप वाला होता है, और निर्गुण ध्यान बिना रूप का।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: स्वकीयहृदयांभोजे दलैर्द्वादशभिर्युते । चिंतयेत्सुस्थिरो भूत्वा संपूर्णं चंद्रमंडलम् ॥ १५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: svakīyahṛdayāṃbhoje dalairdvādaśabhiryute | ciṃtayetsusthiro bhūtvā saṃpūrṇaṃ caṃdramaṃḍalam || 159 ||
verses.translation: Becoming perfectly still, one should picture a full disc of the moon in one's own twelve-petalled lotus of the heart.
verses.hindi: भली-भाँति स्थिर होकर अपने बारह पंखुड़ियों वाले हृदय-कमल में पूर्ण चन्द्र-मण्डल का चिन्तन करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: तन्मध्ये संस्मरेद्योगी स्वर्णसिंहासनं महत् । रत्नैर्नानाविधैर्युक्तं कोमलास्तरणान्वितम् ॥ १६० ॥
verses.transliteration: tanmadhye saṃsmaredyogī svarṇasiṃhāsanaṃ mahat | ratnairnānāvidhairyuktaṃ komalāstaraṇānvitam || 160 ||
verses.translation: In its centre the yogi should picture a great golden throne, set with many kinds of jewels and spread with a soft cushion.
verses.hindi: योगी उसके बीच में एक बड़े सोने के सिंहासन का स्मरण करे, जो अनेक प्रकार के रत्नों से जड़ा है और जिस पर कोमल आसन बिछा है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: तस्योपरि समासीनं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् । नारायणं चतुर्बाहुं शंखचक्रगदाधरम् ॥ १६१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyopari samāsīnaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham | nārāyaṇaṃ caturbāhuṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || 161 ||
verses.translation: (He should meditate on) Narayana seated on it, radiant as ten million suns, four-armed, holding the conch, the discus and the mace,
verses.hindi: उस पर बैठे हुए, करोड़ों सूर्यों जैसी प्रभा वाले, चार भुजाओं वाले, शंख, चक्र और गदा धारण किए नारायण का (ध्यान करे)।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: शरदाकाशसंकाशं पीतवाससमच्युतम् । वनमालालसत्कंठं मकराकारकुंडलम् ॥ १६२ ॥
verses.transliteration: śaradākāśasaṃkāśaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam | vanamālālasatkaṃṭhaṃ makarākārakuṃḍalam || 162 ||
verses.translation: the colour of the autumn sky, clad in yellow, the unfailing one, a garland of forest flowers shining at his throat and earrings shaped like makaras in his ears,
verses.hindi: जो शरद् ऋतु के आकाश जैसे (नीले) हैं, पीले वस्त्र पहने हैं, अच्युत हैं, जिनके कण्ठ में वनमाला शोभित है और कानों में मकर के आकार के कुण्डल हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: मणिमेखलया युक्तं किरीटोज्ज्वलमस्तकम् । प्रसन्नवदनं देवं सर्वकामवरप्रदम् ॥ १६३ ॥
verses.transliteration: maṇimekhalayā yuktaṃ kirīṭojjvalamastakam | prasannavadanaṃ devaṃ sarvakāmavarapradam || 163 ||
verses.translation: wearing a jewelled girdle, his head bright with a crown, his face serene, the god who grants every wish.
verses.hindi: जो मणियों की करधनी पहने हैं, जिनका मस्तक मुकुट से चमक रहा है, जिनका मुख प्रसन्न है, जो सब इच्छाओं का वर देने वाले देव हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: सार्वज्ञ्यादिगुणोपेतं विष्णुमव्ययमीश्वरम् । ध्यायेदनन्यधीरेवमापादतलमस्तकम् ॥ १६४ ॥
verses.transliteration: sārvajñyādiguṇopetaṃ viṣṇumavyayamīśvaram | dhyāyedananyadhīrevamāpādatalamastakam || 164 ||
verses.translation: With a mind fixed on nothing else, one should meditate in this way on Vishnu, the imperishable Lord endowed with omniscience and every virtue, from the soles of his feet to the top of his head.
verses.hindi: सर्वज्ञता आदि गुणों से युक्त, अविनाशी ईश्वर विष्णु का, अनन्य बुद्धि से, पैरों के तलवों से लेकर सिर तक इस प्रकार ध्यान करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा चिंतयेद्योगी शिवं तत्र समाहितः । कोटिचंद्रप्रतीकाशं कर्पूरोज्ज्वलकांतिकम् ॥ १६५ ॥
verses.transliteration: athavā ciṃtayedyogī śivaṃ tatra samāhitaḥ | koṭicaṃdrapratīkāśaṃ karpūrojjvalakāṃtikam || 165 ||
verses.translation: Or the yogi, collected, may picture Shiva there, shining like ten million moons, with a lustre bright as camphor,
verses.hindi: या योगी एकाग्र होकर वहाँ शिव का चिन्तन करे, जो करोड़ों चन्द्रमाओं जैसे चमकते हैं और जिनकी कान्ति कपूर जैसी उजली है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: भस्मभूषितसर्वांगं नागालंकृतविग्रहम् । व्याघ्रचर्मपरीतांगं जटामंडितमस्तकम् ॥ १६६ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhasmabhūṣitasarvāṃgaṃ nāgālaṃkṛtavigraham | vyāghracarmaparītāṃgaṃ jaṭāmaṃḍitamastakam || 166 ||
verses.translation: his whole body adorned with ash, his form decked with serpents, wrapped in a tiger skin, his head crowned with matted locks,
verses.hindi: जिनके सब अंग भस्म से सजे हैं, जिनका शरीर नागों से अलंकृत है, जिन्होंने बाघ की खाल ओढ़ी है और जिनका मस्तक जटाओं से शोभित है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: चतुर्भुजं प्रसन्नास्यं चंद्रभालं त्रिलोचनम् । मृगशूलवराभीतिकरं सर्वज्ञमीश्वरम् ॥ १६७ ॥
verses.transliteration: caturbhujaṃ prasannāsyaṃ caṃdrabhālaṃ trilocanam | mṛgaśūlavarābhītikaraṃ sarvajñamīśvaram || 167 ||
verses.translation: four-armed, serene of face, the moon on his brow, three-eyed, his hands holding a deer and a trident and showing the gestures of blessing and fearlessness, the all-knowing Lord,
verses.hindi: जिनकी चार भुजाएँ हैं, मुख प्रसन्न है, माथे पर चन्द्रमा है, तीन नेत्र हैं, जिनके हाथों में मृग, त्रिशूल, वर और अभय की मुद्रा है, जो सर्वज्ञ ईश्वर हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: गंगावारिलसत्केशं कुंडलोज्ज्वलकर्णकम् । ध्यायेद्देवं स्थिरो भूत्वा सर्वांगं सर्वकामदम् ॥ १६८ ॥
verses.transliteration: gaṃgāvārilasatkeśaṃ kuṃḍalojjvalakarṇakam | dhyāyeddevaṃ sthiro bhūtvā sarvāṃgaṃ sarvakāmadam || 168 ||
verses.translation: the waters of the Ganga shining in his hair, earrings gleaming in his ears: steadily, one should meditate on that god in his full form, the giver of every wish.
verses.hindi: जिनके केशों में गंगाजल शोभित है और कानों में कुण्डल चमक रहे हैं, सब इच्छाएँ पूरी करने वाले उन देव का, स्थिर होकर पूरे रूप में ध्यान करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: सगुणं ध्यानमित्येतद्विष्णोश्चैव शिवस्य वा । कृत्वायोगी भवेद्विष्णोः शिवस्यापि समः स्वयम् ॥ १६९ ॥
verses.transliteration: saguṇaṃ dhyānamityetadviṣṇoścaiva śivasya vā | kṛtvāyogī bhavedviṣṇoḥ śivasyāpi samaḥ svayam || 169 ||
verses.translation: This is meditation with attributes, on Vishnu or on Shiva. Practising it, the yogi himself becomes like Vishnu or like Shiva.
verses.hindi: यह विष्णु या शिव का सगुण ध्यान है। इसे करके योगी स्वयं विष्णु या शिव के समान हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: पुष्पसंयोगतस्तैले यथा गंधः प्रवर्तते । योगिदेहे तथा ध्यानाज्जायते गुणसंक्रमः ॥ १७० ॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpasaṃyogatastaile yathā gaṃdhaḥ pravartate | yogidehe tathā dhyānājjāyate guṇasaṃkramaḥ || 170 ||
verses.translation: Just as oil takes on fragrance from contact with flowers, so through meditation the qualities (of the deity) pass into the yogi's body.
verses.hindi: जैसे फूलों के संग से तेल में सुगन्ध आ जाती है, वैसे ही ध्यान से योगी की देह में (इष्टदेव के) गुण आ जाते हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञः सत्यसंकल्पः सर्वशक्तिसमन्वितः । जीवन्मुक्तश्चरेद्योगी सायुज्यं चांततो व्रजेत् ॥ १७१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvajñaḥ satyasaṃkalpaḥ sarvaśaktisamanvitaḥ | jīvanmuktaścaredyogī sāyujyaṃ cāṃtato vrajet || 171 ||
verses.translation: Then the yogi moves about liberated while alive, all-knowing, true in resolve and endowed with every power, and in the end attains union with the Lord.
verses.hindi: तब योगी सर्वज्ञ, सत्य संकल्प वाला और सब शक्तियों से युक्त होकर जीवन्मुक्त विचरता है, और अन्त में सायुज्य (ईश्वर से एकता) पाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मासने स्थितो योगी स्थिरकायः समाहितः । निमील्यनयने पश्येद्भ्रुवोर्मध्यं सदाधिया ॥ १७२ ॥
verses.transliteration: padmāsane sthito yogī sthirakāyaḥ samāhitaḥ | nimīlyanayane paśyedbhruvormadhyaṃ sadādhiyā || 172 ||
verses.translation: Seated in the lotus pose, body still and mind collected, the yogi should close his eyes and always look inwardly at the point between the brows.
verses.hindi: पद्मासन में बैठा, स्थिर शरीर और एकाग्र मन वाला योगी आँखें बन्द करके सदा बुद्धि से भौंहों के बीच देखे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यते प्रथमाभ्यासे नभः कृष्णं तु केवलम् । ततस्तारानिभं तेजो दृश्यते तु कदाकदा ॥ १७३ ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛśyate prathamābhyāse nabhaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tu kevalam | tatastārānibhaṃ tejo dṛśyate tu kadākadā || 173 ||
verses.translation: In early practice only a dark sky is seen. Then, now and then, a light like a star appears.
verses.hindi: पहले अभ्यास में केवल काला आकाश दिखाई देता है। फिर कभी-कभी तारे जैसा प्रकाश दिखता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: नानावर्णयुतं पश्चादस्थिरं दृष्टिगं भवेत् । ततोऽर्धचंद्रसंकाशं शून्यचक्रसमं ततः ॥ १७४ ॥
verses.transliteration: nānāvarṇayutaṃ paścādasthiraṃ dṛṣṭigaṃ bhavet | tato'rdhacaṃdrasaṃkāśaṃ śūnyacakrasamaṃ tataḥ || 174 ||
verses.translation: After that a flickering light of many colours comes into view; then one like a half moon, then one like an empty ring.
verses.hindi: उसके बाद अनेक रंगों वाला, अस्थिर प्रकाश दिखाई देता है; फिर आधे चन्द्रमा जैसा, फिर खाली चक्र (घेरे) जैसा।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णचक्रसमं पश्चात्सूर्यमंडलसंनिभम् । दृश्यते परमं ज्योतिर्ब्रह्मभूतं निरामयम् ॥ १७५ ॥
verses.transliteration: pūrṇacakrasamaṃ paścātsūryamaṃḍalasaṃnibham | dṛśyate paramaṃ jyotirbrahmabhūtaṃ nirāmayam || 175 ||
verses.translation: Then one like a full disc, and after that the supreme light, like the disc of the sun, which is Brahman itself and spotless.
verses.hindi: फिर पूरे चक्र जैसा, और उसके बाद सूर्य-मण्डल जैसा परम ज्योति दिखाई देता है, जो ब्रह्म-रूप और निर्मल है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: परमानंदसंदोहमज्ञानध्वांतनाशनम् । योगिनो मनसस्तुष्टिकरं क्लेशहरं परम् ॥ १७६ ॥
verses.transliteration: paramānaṃdasaṃdohamajñānadhvāṃtanāśanam | yogino manasastuṣṭikaraṃ kleśaharaṃ param || 176 ||
verses.translation: It is full of supreme bliss, destroys the darkness of ignorance, satisfies the yogi's mind, and is the highest remover of suffering.
verses.hindi: वह परम आनन्द से भरा है, अज्ञान के अँधेरे को मिटाता है, योगी के मन को तृप्त करता है और सब क्लेशों को हरने वाला परम (प्रकाश) है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: क्षणं दृष्टिगतं भूत्वा पुनस्तत्प्रविलीयते । ततोऽभ्यासे दृढीभूते स्थिरं भवति कालतः ॥ १७७ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭigataṃ bhūtvā punastatpravilīyate | tato'bhyāse dṛḍhībhūte sthiraṃ bhavati kālataḥ || 177 ||
verses.translation: It is seen for a moment and then vanishes again. Then, as practice grows firm, it becomes steady in time.
verses.hindi: वह एक क्षण दिखकर फिर लुप्त हो जाता है। फिर अभ्यास दृढ़ होने पर समय के साथ स्थिर हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: दिनानुदिनमित्येवं निर्विघ्नाभ्यासतो दृढम् । क्रमाद्विस्तारमायाति तज्ज्योतिः परमं महत् ॥ १७८ ॥
verses.transliteration: dinānudinamityevaṃ nirvighnābhyāsato dṛḍham | kramādvistāramāyāti tajjyotiḥ paramaṃ mahat || 178 ||
verses.translation: So, day after day, through firm practice without interruption, that great supreme light gradually spreads.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार दिन-प्रतिदिन बिना विघ्न के दृढ़ अभ्यास से वह परम महान ज्योति क्रम से फैलती जाती है।

verses.sanskrit: आदौ गृहगतं सर्वं वस्तु ध्याने निरीक्ष्यते । ततो बाह्यं ततो दूरं ततो दूरतरं पुनः ॥ १७९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ādau gṛhagataṃ sarvaṃ vastu dhyāne nirīkṣyate | tato bāhyaṃ tato dūraṃ tato dūrataraṃ punaḥ || 179 ||
verses.translation: At first everything in the house is seen in meditation; then what is outside, then what is far, and then what is farther still.
verses.hindi: पहले ध्यान में घर के भीतर की सब वस्तुएँ दिखाई देती हैं; फिर बाहर की, फिर दूर की, और फिर उससे भी दूर की।

verses.sanskrit: नानावनानि रम्याणि निर्मलानि सरांसि च । समीपस्थानि दृश्यंते गिरीणां शिखराणि च ॥ १८० ॥
verses.transliteration: nānāvanāni ramyāṇi nirmalāni sarāṃsi ca | samīpasthāni dṛśyaṃte girīṇāṃ śikharāṇi ca || 180 ||
verses.translation: Many lovely forests, clear lakes and mountain peaks are seen as if close by.
verses.hindi: अनेक सुन्दर वन, निर्मल सरोवर और पर्वतों की चोटियाँ पास में ही दिखाई देती हैं।

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धा महर्षयश्चैव दृश्यंतेऽबरचारिणः । तारकामंडलं सर्वं देवतायतनानि च ॥ १८१ ॥
verses.transliteration: siddhā maharṣayaścaiva dṛśyaṃte'baracāriṇaḥ | tārakāmaṃḍalaṃ sarvaṃ devatāyatanāni ca || 181 ||
verses.translation: The accomplished ones and great sages who move through the sky are seen too, the whole sphere of the stars, and the abodes of the gods.
verses.hindi: आकाश में चलने वाले सिद्ध और महर्षि, सारा तारा-मण्डल और देवताओं के धाम भी दिखाई देते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: एवं क्रमेण कालेन योगिनोऽभ्यासयोगतः । दिव्या दृष्टिर्भवत्येव त्रैलोक्यालोकने क्षमा ॥ १८२ ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṃ krameṇa kālena yogino'bhyāsayogataḥ | divyā dṛṣṭirbhavatyeva trailokyālokane kṣamā || 182 ||
verses.translation: In this way, step by step and in time, through steady practice, the yogi surely gains a divine sight able to see the three worlds.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार क्रम से, समय के साथ, अभ्यास-योग से योगी को निश्चय ही दिव्य दृष्टि मिलती है, जो तीनों लोकों को देखने में समर्थ है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं ज्योतिर्मयो भूत्वा योगी तद्गतमानसः । ब्रह्मण्येव लयं याति परे ज्योतिःस्वरूपिणि ॥ १८३ ॥
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ jyotirmayo bhūtvā yogī tadgatamānasaḥ | brahmaṇyeva layaṃ yāti pare jyotiḥsvarūpiṇi || 183 ||
verses.translation: Becoming full of light himself, his mind absorbed in it, the yogi dissolves into the supreme Brahman whose nature is light.
verses.hindi: स्वयं ज्योतिर्मय होकर, उसी में मन लगाए योगी ज्योति-स्वरूप परम ब्रह्म में ही लीन हो जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: समाधिमधुना वक्ष्ये भवपाशनिकृंतनम् । समाधानं हि चित्तस्य समाधिं मुनयो विदुः ॥ १८४ ॥
verses.transliteration: samādhimadhunā vakṣye bhavapāśanikṛṃtanam | samādhānaṃ hi cittasya samādhiṃ munayo viduḥ || 184 ||
verses.translation: Now I shall describe absorption, which cuts the noose of worldly existence. The sages call the complete settling of the mind absorption.
verses.hindi: अब मैं समाधि का वर्णन करूँगा, जो संसार के बन्धन को काटती है। मुनि चित्त के पूर्ण समाधान (स्थिर होने) को समाधि कहते हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: समाधिर्हठयोगेन राजयोगेन वा भवेत् । द्विविधोपि विधिस्तस्य सम्यगत्र निरूप्यते ॥ १८५ ॥
verses.transliteration: samādhirhaṭhayogena rājayogena vā bhavet | dvividhopi vidhistasya samyagatra nirūpyate || 185 ||
verses.translation: Absorption can come through hatha yoga or through raja yoga. Both methods are explained here in full.
verses.hindi: समाधि हठयोग से भी होती है और राजयोग से भी। यहाँ उसकी दोनों विधियाँ भली-भाँति बताई जाती हैं।

verses.sanskrit: गुदमेढ्रांतरे वामपादपार्ष्णिं नियोजयेत् । सीवनीमध्यभागे तु संस्थितः कोमलासने ॥ १८६ ॥
verses.transliteration: gudameḍhrāṃtare vāmapādapārṣṇiṃ niyojayet | sīvanīmadhyabhāge tu saṃsthitaḥ komalāsane || 186 ||
verses.translation: Seated on a soft seat, place the left heel between the anus and the genitals, at the middle of the perineum.
verses.hindi: कोमल आसन पर बैठकर बाएँ पैर की एड़ी को गुदा और जननेन्द्रिय के बीच, सीवनी के मध्य भाग पर लगाए।

verses.sanskrit: सीवनीपार्ष्णिसंबंधं दृढं कुर्यात्तथाऽचलम् । तस्मिँस्तु शिथिलेऽपानः सम्यगूर्ध्वं न गच्छति ॥ १८७ ॥
verses.transliteration: sīvanīpārṣṇisaṃbaṃdhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ kuryāttathā'calam | tasmi~stu śithile'pānaḥ samyagūrdhvaṃ na gacchati || 187 ||
verses.translation: Keep the contact of heel and perineum firm and unmoving. If it loosens, apana does not rise properly.
verses.hindi: सीवनी और एड़ी का सम्बन्ध दृढ़ और अचल रखे। उसके ढीला होने पर अपान ठीक से ऊपर नहीं जाता।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: सरलं मेरुदंडं च जिह्वाग्रं दंतमध्यगम् । कृत्वा ध्यानं ततः कुर्याद्भ्रूमध्ये स्थिरमानसः ॥ १८८ ॥
verses.transliteration: saralaṃ merudaṃḍaṃ ca jihvāgraṃ daṃtamadhyagam | kṛtvā dhyānaṃ tataḥ kuryādbhrūmadhye sthiramānasaḥ || 188 ||
verses.translation: With the spine straight and the tip of the tongue between the teeth, meditate with a steady mind on the point between the brows.
verses.hindi: मेरुदण्ड को सीधा रखकर और जीभ के अगले भाग को दाँतों के बीच रखकर, फिर स्थिर मन से भौंहों के बीच ध्यान करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अनेनापानवायुस्तु व्रजेदूर्ध्वं न संशयः । निबद्धो मूलबंधेन नीचैर्गतिनिरोधतः ॥ १८९ ॥
verses.transliteration: anenāpānavāyustu vrajedūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | nibaddho mūlabaṃdhena nīcairgatinirodhataḥ || 189 ||
verses.translation: By this the apana breath, held by the root lock and blocked from going down, surely rises upward.
verses.hindi: इससे मूलबन्ध से बँधा अपान वायु, नीचे जाने का मार्ग रुक जाने से, निश्चय ही ऊपर जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: मूलाधारात्समुत्थाय स्वाधिष्ठानालयं व्रजेत् । शनैरभ्यासयोगेन तस्मादुपरि गच्छति ॥ १९० ॥
verses.transliteration: mūlādhārātsamutthāya svādhiṣṭhānālayaṃ vrajet | śanairabhyāsayogena tasmādupari gacchati || 190 ||
verses.translation: Rising from the root centre, it goes to the seat of the svadhishthana centre, and with steady practice rises above it.
verses.hindi: वह मूलाधार से उठकर स्वाधिष्ठान के स्थान पर जाता है, और धीरे-धीरे अभ्यास से उससे ऊपर जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: नाभिचक्रसमीपे तु संभूय परितः शनैः । कुंडलीं बोधयित्वाथ क्रमादूर्ध्वं प्रधावति ॥ १९१ ॥
verses.transliteration: nābhicakrasamīpe tu saṃbhūya paritaḥ śanaiḥ | kuṃḍalīṃ bodhayitvātha kramādūrdhvaṃ pradhāvati || 191 ||
verses.translation: Gathering slowly all around near the navel centre, it wakes kundalini and then rushes upward stage by stage.
verses.hindi: नाभि-चक्र के पास चारों ओर धीरे-धीरे इकट्ठा होकर, कुण्डलिनी को जगाकर, फिर वह क्रम से ऊपर दौड़ता है।

verses.sanskrit: ततः कतिपयैरेवं दिनैर्नाभिं विलंघ्य वै । हृदयं कंठदेशं च समायाति समीरणः ॥ १९२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ katipayairevaṃ dinairnābhiṃ vilaṃghya vai | hṛdayaṃ kaṃṭhadeśaṃ ca samāyāti samīraṇaḥ || 192 ||
verses.translation: Then, in a few days, having passed the navel in this way, the breath comes to the heart and the region of the throat.
verses.hindi: फिर कुछ दिनों में इसी प्रकार नाभि को पार करके वायु हृदय और कण्ठ प्रदेश तक आ जाती है।

verses.sanskrit: ततो बुद्ध्या नयेदूर्ध्वं भ्रूमध्यं योगवित्तमः । ब्रह्मरंध्रं ततो नीत्वा तत्रैव स्थिरतां नयेत् ॥ १९३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato buddhyā nayedūrdhvaṃ bhrūmadhyaṃ yogavittamaḥ | brahmaraṃdhraṃ tato nītvā tatraiva sthiratāṃ nayet || 193 ||
verses.translation: Then the best knower of yoga should lead it with his understanding up to the point between the brows, and then to the crown, and make it steady there.
verses.hindi: फिर योग का श्रेष्ठ ज्ञाता बुद्धि से उसे ऊपर भौंहों के बीच ले जाए, फिर ब्रह्मरन्ध्र तक ले जाकर वहीं स्थिर करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: स्थित्वा तत्र यथाशक्ति भ्रूमध्यं पुनरानयेत् । प्राणं प्रवेशयेद्देहे क्रमादवतरन् सुधीः ॥ १९४ ॥
verses.transliteration: sthitvā tatra yathāśakti bhrūmadhyaṃ punarānayet | prāṇaṃ praveśayeddehe kramādavataran sudhīḥ || 194 ||
verses.translation: After staying there as long as he can, he should bring it back to the brows; and the wise practitioner, lowering it step by step, should return the breath to the body.
verses.hindi: वहाँ यथाशक्ति ठहरकर उसे फिर भौंहों के बीच लाए; और बुद्धिमान साधक क्रम से नीचे उतारते हुए प्राण को शरीर में प्रवेश कराए।

verses.transliteration: evaṃ kuryātsadābhyāsaṃ pratidinamataṃdritaḥ | yathā mūrdhani prāṇasya sarvasyārohaṇaṃ bhavet || 195 ||
verses.translation: He should practise like this every day without fail, so that the whole of the breath comes to rise to the head.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार प्रतिदिन, आलस्य छोड़कर, सदा अभ्यास करे, जिससे पूरा प्राण सिर तक चढ़ने लगे।

verses.transliteration: annāhāraṃ parityajya kevalaṃ dugdhabhugbhavet | śarīralaghutābhāve prāṇākṛṣṭirna jāyate || 196 ||
verses.translation: He should give up solid food and live on milk alone. Unless the body is light, the breath cannot be drawn up.
verses.hindi: अन्न का भोजन छोड़कर केवल दूध पर रहे। शरीर हल्का न हो, तो प्राण का (ऊपर) खिंचना नहीं होता।

verses.transliteration: prāṇasyārohaṇe tatra catasro gatayaḥ kramāt | bhavaṃti yogino dehe nityamabhyāsayogataḥ || 197 ||
verses.translation: Through daily practice, four kinds of movement appear in turn in the yogi's body as the breath rises.
verses.hindi: नित्य अभ्यास से योगी के शरीर में प्राण के ऊपर चढ़ने की चार गतियाँ क्रम से होती हैं।

verses.sanskrit: पिपीलिकासमा पूर्वं ततो दर्दुरसंनिभा । गतिः सर्पोपमा पश्चाद्धंसस्य तदनंतरम् ॥ १९८ ॥
verses.transliteration: pipīlikāsamā pūrvaṃ tato dardurasaṃnibhā | gatiḥ sarpopamā paścāddhaṃsasya tadanaṃtaram || 198 ||
verses.translation: First it moves like an ant, then like a frog, then like a snake, and after that like a swan.
verses.hindi: पहले चींटी जैसी, फिर मेंढक जैसी, फिर साँप जैसी, और उसके बाद हंस जैसी गति होती है।

verses.sanskrit: यदा हंसगतिः सम्यक् क्रमात्प्राणस्य जायते । तदा शरीरात्प्राणस्य सम्यगाकर्षणं भवेत् ॥ १९९ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā haṃsagatiḥ samyak kramātprāṇasya jāyate | tadā śarīrātprāṇasya samyagākarṣaṇaṃ bhavet || 199 ||
verses.translation: When the breath's swan-like movement comes about fully in due course, then the breath is drawn completely out of the body.
verses.hindi: जब क्रम से प्राण की हंस-गति भली-भाँति होने लगे, तब शरीर से प्राण का पूरा खिंचाव होता है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वांगेभ्यः समाकृष्टो यदा प्राणानिलो व्रजेत् । ब्रह्मरंध्रमशेषेण समाधिर्जायते तदा ॥ २०० ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvāṃgebhyaḥ samākṛṣṭo yadā prāṇānilo vrajet | brahmaraṃdhramaśeṣeṇa samādhirjāyate tadā || 200 ||
verses.translation: When the breath, drawn in from every limb, passes wholly into the crown, then absorption arises.
verses.hindi: जब सब अंगों से खिंचकर प्राणवायु पूरी तरह ब्रह्मरन्ध्र में चली जाती है, तब समाधि होती है।

chapters.title: Kundalini-Amrita — The Inner Elixir of Immortality
chapters.summary: The awakening of Kundalini energy ascending to Sahasrara, showering soma/amrita throughout the physical and subtle nadis, dissolving decay and culminating in Samadhi.

verses.sanskrit: देहः शून्यो भवेत्सर्वो जगद्विस्मरणं भवेत् । स्वप्रकाशे परानंदे मनोवृत्तिर्विलीयते ॥ २०१ ॥
verses.transliteration: dehaḥ śūnyo bhavetsarvo jagadvismaraṇaṃ bhavet | svaprakāśe parānaṃde manovṛttirvilīyate || 201 ||
verses.translation: (Then) the whole body seems empty, the world is forgotten, and the movement of the mind dissolves into self-luminous supreme bliss.
verses.hindi: (तब) सारा शरीर शून्य-सा हो जाता है, जगत् भूल जाता है, और स्वयं-प्रकाश परम आनन्द में मन की वृत्ति लीन हो जाती है।

verses.sanskrit: निमग्नस्तन्मयो भूत्वा तस्मिन्नानंदसागरे । दीर्घकाले गते योगी क्षणमात्रं हि मन्यते ॥ २०२ ॥
verses.transliteration: nimagnastanmayo bhūtvā tasminnānaṃdasāgare | dīrghakāle gate yogī kṣaṇamātraṃ hi manyate || 202 ||
verses.translation: Plunged into that ocean of bliss and one with it, the yogi takes a long stretch of time to have been only a moment.
verses.hindi: उस आनन्द के सागर में डूबकर, तन्मय होकर, योगी लम्बा समय बीत जाने पर भी उसे एक क्षण ही समझता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यो विज्ञातसंकेतो योगिनं बोधयेत्ततः । कर्णनादैः शिरस्तालैरुष्णवारिनिषेचनैः ॥ २०३ ॥
verses.transliteration: śiṣyo vijñātasaṃketo yoginaṃ bodhayettataḥ | karṇanādaiḥ śirastālairuṣṇavāriniṣecanaiḥ || 203 ||
verses.translation: Then a student who knows the agreed signal should rouse the yogi with sounds in his ears, light taps on his head and sprinkles of warm water.
verses.hindi: फिर संकेत जानने वाला शिष्य योगी को कानों में ध्वनि करके, सिर पर हल्की थपकी देकर और गुनगुना जल छिड़ककर जगाए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: शिष्यं विनापि शक्नोति योगी प्राणावरोहणम् । स्वयं कर्तुं न संदेहः कालेनाभ्यासपाटवात् ॥ २०४ ॥
verses.transliteration: śiṣyaṃ vināpi śaknoti yogī prāṇāvarohaṇam | svayaṃ kartuṃ na saṃdehaḥ kālenābhyāsapāṭavāt || 204 ||
verses.translation: In time, through skill in practice, the yogi can bring the breath down by himself even without a student; there is no doubt of it.
verses.hindi: समय के साथ अभ्यास की कुशलता से योगी शिष्य के बिना भी स्वयं प्राण को नीचे उतार सकता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अवतार्य ततो योगी प्राणं संकल्पयोगतः । स्थापयित्वा यथास्थानं स्वस्थदेहः सुखं चरेत् ॥ २०५ ॥
verses.transliteration: avatārya tato yogī prāṇaṃ saṃkalpayogataḥ | sthāpayitvā yathāsthānaṃ svasthadehaḥ sukhaṃ caret || 205 ||
verses.translation: Then, bringing the breath down by force of will and settling it in its place, the yogi goes about at ease with a healthy body.
verses.hindi: तब योगी संकल्प के बल से प्राण को नीचे उतारकर, उसे यथास्थान स्थापित करके, स्वस्थ शरीर से सुखपूर्वक विचरे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: अथवोत्कर्षयेत्प्राणं पूर्वोक्तविधिना सुधीः । पश्चिमेनैव मार्गेण नित्यं केवलकुंभकात् ॥ २०६ ॥
verses.transliteration: athavotkarṣayetprāṇaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā sudhīḥ | paścimenaiva mārgeṇa nityaṃ kevalakuṃbhakāt || 206 ||
verses.translation: Or the wise practitioner may raise the breath by the back path alone, through daily retention without inhaling or exhaling, by the method given earlier.
verses.hindi: या बुद्धिमान साधक पहले बताई विधि से, नित्य केवल-कुम्भक द्वारा, पश्चिम मार्ग से ही प्राण को ऊपर उठाए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: आपूर्य कुंभितो वायुः पृष्ठमार्गेण मस्तकम् । अल्पमल्पं व्रजेदादौ पश्चात्पूर्णं प्ररोहति ॥ २०७ ॥
verses.transliteration: āpūrya kuṃbhito vāyuḥ pṛṣṭhamārgeṇa mastakam | alpamalpaṃ vrajedādau paścātpūrṇaṃ prarohati || 207 ||
verses.translation: The air, filled in and held, at first goes a little at a time along the back towards the head, and later climbs there in full.
verses.hindi: भरकर रोकी गई वायु पीठ के मार्ग से सिर की ओर पहले थोड़ी-थोड़ी जाती है, फिर पूरी चढ़ जाती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु कुंभिते प्राणे रेचनं नैव जायते । तदा पश्चिममार्गेण समाधिर्जायते ध्रुवम् ॥ २०८ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā tu kuṃbhite prāṇe recanaṃ naiva jāyate | tadā paścimamārgeṇa samādhirjāyate dhruvam || 208 ||
verses.translation: When the held breath no longer goes out at all, then absorption surely arises by the back path.
verses.hindi: जब रोके गए प्राण का रेचन (बाहर निकलना) होता ही नहीं, तब पश्चिम मार्ग से निश्चय ही समाधि होती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: समाध्यभ्यासतः प्राणो योगिनोवशितामियात् । स यथा प्रेरयत्येनं तत्रैवायाति सत्वरम् ॥ २०९ ॥
verses.transliteration: samādhyabhyāsataḥ prāṇo yoginovaśitāmiyāt | sa yathā prerayatyenaṃ tatraivāyāti satvaram || 209 ||
verses.translation: Through practice of absorption the breath comes under the yogi's control. Wherever he sends it, it goes there at once.
verses.hindi: समाधि के अभ्यास से प्राण योगी के वश में हो जाता है। वह उसे जहाँ भेजता है, वह तुरन्त वहीं चला जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: संकल्पानुविधायित्वं यदा प्राणस्य जायते । तदा विचित्रसामर्थ्यं योगिनो भवति ध्रुवम् ॥ २१० ॥
verses.transliteration: saṃkalpānuvidhāyitvaṃ yadā prāṇasya jāyate | tadā vicitrasāmarthyaṃ yogino bhavati dhruvam || 210 ||
verses.translation: When the breath comes to follow his will, wonderful powers surely arise in the yogi.
verses.hindi: जब प्राण संकल्प के अनुसार चलने लगता है, तब योगी में निश्चय ही अद्भुत सामर्थ्य आ जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: बहिर्देशे यदा योगी धारणां कुरुते चिरम् । त्यक्त्वा देहं व्रजेत्प्राणो बहिरेव न संशयः ॥ २११ ॥
verses.transliteration: bahirdeśe yadā yogī dhāraṇāṃ kurute ciram | tyaktvā dehaṃ vrajetprāṇo bahireva na saṃśayaḥ || 211 ||
verses.translation: When the yogi concentrates on some place outside for a long time, the breath leaves the body and goes out there; there is no doubt of it.
verses.hindi: जब योगी बहुत देर तक बाहर के किसी स्थान पर धारणा करता है, तब प्राण शरीर छोड़कर बाहर ही चला जाता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: कायः शवत्वमायाति योगी वायुसमो भवेत् । देहबंधाद्विनिर्मुक्तः स्वातंत्र्यं परमं व्रजेत् ॥ २१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: kāyaḥ śavatvamāyāti yogī vāyusamo bhavet | dehabaṃdhādvinirmuktaḥ svātaṃtryaṃ paramaṃ vrajet || 212 ||
verses.translation: The body becomes like a corpse and the yogi becomes like the wind; freed from the bondage of the body, he gains supreme freedom.
verses.hindi: शरीर शव जैसा हो जाता है और योगी वायु के समान हो जाता है; देह के बन्धन से छूटकर वह परम स्वतन्त्रता पाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अणुवत्सूक्ष्मरूपोसौ विचरेद्भुवनत्रये । इयमेवाणिमा नाम सिद्धिः सिद्धैरुदीरिता ॥ २१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: aṇuvatsūkṣmarūposau vicaredbhuvanatraye | iyamevāṇimā nāma siddhiḥ siddhairudīritā || 213 ||
verses.translation: In a form as subtle as an atom he roams the three worlds. This is what the accomplished call the power of minuteness.
verses.hindi: वह अणु के समान सूक्ष्म रूप से तीनों लोकों में विचरता है। सिद्धों ने इसी को अणिमा नाम की सिद्धि कहा है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: स्वदेहे परदेहे वा जीविते वा मृतेऽथवा । यत्रांतर्गंतुमीहेत प्रविशत्यचिरं ध्रुवम् ॥ २१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: svadehe paradehe vā jīvite vā mṛte'thavā | yatrāṃtargaṃtumīheta praviśatyaciraṃ dhruvam || 214 ||
verses.translation: Into his own body or another's, living or dead, whichever he wishes to enter, he surely enters it quickly.
verses.hindi: अपनी देह में या दूसरे की देह में, जीवित या मृत, जिसमें भी वह प्रवेश करना चाहे, उसमें निश्चय ही शीघ्र प्रवेश कर जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: प्रविश्य धनिनां देहे नृपादीनामवारितः । भुक्त्वा भोगानशेषेण स्वदेहं पुनराविशेत् ॥ २१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: praviśya dhanināṃ dehe nṛpādīnāmavāritaḥ | bhuktvā bhogānaśeṣeṇa svadehaṃ punarāviśet || 215 ||
verses.translation: Entering unhindered the bodies of the wealthy, of kings and others, and enjoying every pleasure, he returns again to his own body.
verses.hindi: बिना रोक-टोक धनवानों और राजाओं आदि की देह में प्रवेश करके, सब भोग भोगकर, फिर अपनी देह में लौट आता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: आकाशे दीर्घमध्वानं गत्वा दृष्ट्वा च तद्गतान् । पदार्थानखिलाँस्तूर्णं स्वदेहं पुनराविशेत् ॥ २१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: ākāśe dīrghamadhvānaṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā ca tadgatān | padārthānakhilā~stūrṇaṃ svadehaṃ punarāviśet || 216 ||
verses.translation: Travelling a long way through the sky and seeing everything there, he quickly returns to his own body.
verses.hindi: आकाश में लम्बी दूरी तय करके और वहाँ की सब वस्तुएँ देखकर, वह शीघ्र अपनी देह में लौट आता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: स्वदेहे वृद्धतां याते क्षीणे वा व्याधिसंयुते । हित्वा देहं विशेदन्यं कायं वा नवयौवनम् ॥ २१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: svadehe vṛddhatāṃ yāte kṣīṇe vā vyādhisaṃyute | hitvā dehaṃ viśedanyaṃ kāyaṃ vā navayauvanam || 217 ||
verses.translation: When his own body grows old, weak or diseased, he may leave it and enter another, youthful body.
verses.hindi: अपनी देह के बूढ़ी, दुर्बल या रोगी हो जाने पर वह उसे छोड़कर किसी दूसरी नई युवा देह में प्रवेश कर सकता है।

verses.sanskrit: जीवन्मुक्तिरियं प्रोक्ता जीवतां बंधहारिणी । शास्त्रावलोकनेनैव जीवन्मुक्तो न जायते ॥ २१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: jīvanmuktiriyaṃ proktā jīvatāṃ baṃdhahāriṇī | śāstrāvalokanenaiva jīvanmukto na jāyate || 218 ||
verses.translation: This is called liberation while living, which removes bondage while one is still alive. No one becomes liberated in life merely by reading texts.
verses.hindi: इसे जीवन्मुक्ति कहा गया है, जो जीवित रहते हुए ही बन्धन को हर लेती है। केवल शास्त्र पढ़ने से कोई जीवन्मुक्त नहीं होता।

verses.sanskrit: सिद्धयोऽन्याश्च कालेन जायंते स्वयमेव हि । योगिनो नित्ययुक्तस्य मुक्तस्य देहबंधनात् ॥ २१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: siddhayo'nyāśca kālena jāyaṃte svayameva hi | yogino nityayuktasya muktasya dehabaṃdhanāt || 219 ||
verses.translation: For a yogi always engaged in yoga and free of the body's bondage, other powers too arise of themselves in time.
verses.hindi: जो योगी नित्य योग में लगा है और देह के बन्धन से मुक्त है, उसे समय के साथ दूसरी सिद्धियाँ भी अपने आप मिल जाती हैं।

verses.sanskrit: राजयोगसमाधेस्तु भेदा बहुविधा मताः । तेषु मार्गद्वयं वक्ष्ये सत्वरं योगसिद्धिदम् ॥ २२० ॥
verses.transliteration: rājayogasamādhestu bhedā bahuvidhā matāḥ | teṣu mārgadvayaṃ vakṣye satvaraṃ yogasiddhidam || 220 ||
verses.translation: Many kinds of raja-yoga absorption are recognised. Of them I shall describe two paths that quickly bring success in yoga.
verses.hindi: राजयोग की समाधि के बहुत से भेद माने गए हैं। उनमें से मैं दो मार्ग बताऊँगा, जो शीघ्र योग की सिद्धि देते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: खेचरीमुद्रया वापि नादश्रवणतस्तथा । निर्विकल्पसमाधिः स्यात्कालेनाभ्यासयोगतः ॥ २२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: khecarīmudrayā vāpi nādaśravaṇatastathā | nirvikalpasamādhiḥ syātkālenābhyāsayogataḥ || 221 ||
verses.translation: Through the khechari seal, or through listening to the inner sound, absorption without any thought arises in time through practice.
verses.hindi: खेचरी मुद्रा से, या नाद (आन्तरिक ध्वनि) सुनने से, समय के साथ अभ्यास द्वारा निर्विकल्प समाधि होती है।

verses.sanskrit: खेचरीसाधनं तत्र प्रथमं परिकीर्त्यते । मुख्या सा सर्वमुद्रासु सेविता योगिपुंगवैः ॥ २२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: khecarīsādhanaṃ tatra prathamaṃ parikīrtyate | mukhyā sā sarvamudrāsu sevitā yogipuṃgavaiḥ || 222 ||
verses.translation: Of these the practice of khechari is described first. The greatest yogis have practised it; it is the chief of all seals.
verses.hindi: उनमें पहले खेचरी की साधना बताई जाती है। श्रेष्ठ योगियों ने इसका सेवन किया है; यह सब मुद्राओं में मुख्य है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: जिह्वाधो नाडिका सूक्ष्मा जिह्वांतर्गतिरोधिका । छेदयेत्तां क्रमाद्धीरः सूक्ष्मशस्त्रेण युक्तितः ॥ २२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: jihvādho nāḍikā sūkṣmā jihvāṃtargatirodhikā | chedayettāṃ kramāddhīraḥ sūkṣmaśastreṇa yuktitaḥ || 223 ||
verses.translation: Under the tongue is a fine strand that keeps the tongue from going back. The steady practitioner should cut it skilfully, little by little, with a fine blade.
verses.hindi: जीभ के नीचे एक बारीक नाड़ी (झिल्ली) है, जो जीभ को भीतर की ओर जाने से रोकती है। धीर साधक उसे युक्ति से बारीक शस्त्र द्वारा क्रम से काटे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: यावज्जिह्वा परावृत्य संस्पृशेन्नैव घंटिकाम् । शिरां संछेदयेत्तावदल्पमल्पं न वै सकृत् ॥ २२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yāvajjihvā parāvṛtya saṃspṛśennaiva ghaṃṭikām | śirāṃ saṃchedayettāvadalpamalpaṃ na vai sakṛt || 224 ||
verses.translation: Until the tongue can turn back and touch the uvula, keep cutting that strand a little at a time, never all at once.
verses.hindi: जब तक जीभ उलटकर घण्टिका (कौवे) को न छू ले, तब तक उस नाड़ी को थोड़ा-थोड़ा काटता रहे, एक ही बार में नहीं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: छेदस्थाने शिवाचूर्णं सैंधवेन समन्वितम् । दद्यादल्पं प्रतिच्छेदं व्रणस्तेन प्रपूर्यते ॥ २२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: chedasthāne śivācūrṇaṃ saiṃdhavena samanvitam | dadyādalpaṃ praticchedaṃ vraṇastena prapūryate || 225 ||
verses.translation: After each cut, apply a little powdered haritaki mixed with rock salt to the cut; this heals the wound.
verses.hindi: हर बार काटने के बाद कटे हुए स्थान पर हरड़ का चूर्ण सेंधा नमक मिलाकर थोड़ा लगाए; उससे घाव भर जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: व्रणे पूर्णे पुनश्छेदो रोपणं छेदनं पुनः । एवंक्रमेण षण्मासाच्छिराबंधो विनश्यति ॥ २२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: vraṇe pūrṇe punaśchedo ropaṇaṃ chedanaṃ punaḥ | evaṃkrameṇa ṣaṇmāsācchirābaṃdho vinaśyati || 226 ||
verses.translation: When the wound has healed, cut again; let it heal, and cut again. In this way, in six months, the strand's hold is gone.
verses.hindi: घाव भरने पर फिर काटे, फिर भरने दे, फिर काटे। इस क्रम से छह महीने में नाड़ी का बन्धन मिट जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: छेदनानंतरं कुर्याच्चालनं दोहनं तथा । जिह्वाग्रं करयुग्मेन गृहीत्वा घृतयोगतः ॥ २२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: chedanānaṃtaraṃ kuryāccālanaṃ dohanaṃ tathā | jihvāgraṃ karayugmena gṛhītvā ghṛtayogataḥ || 227 ||
verses.translation: After the cutting, practise moving and milking the tongue: with ghee, hold the tip of the tongue in both hands (and draw it gently).
verses.hindi: काटने के बाद जीभ को हिलाने और दुहने का अभ्यास करे: घी लगाकर जीभ के अगले भाग को दोनों हाथों से पकड़कर (धीरे खींचे)।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: क्रमेण वृद्धिमायातां निष्पीड्यांगुलितः शनैः । जिह्वां प्रवेशयेद्योगी कपालकुहरे ततः ॥ २२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: krameṇa vṛddhimāyātāṃ niṣpīḍyāṃgulitaḥ śanaiḥ | jihvāṃ praveśayedyogī kapālakuhare tataḥ || 228 ||
verses.translation: Pressing the tongue gently with the fingers as it lengthens over time, the yogi should then insert it into the cavity behind the nasal passage.
verses.hindi: क्रम से बढ़ी हुई जीभ को उँगलियों से धीरे-धीरे दबाकर, फिर योगी उसे कपाल-कुहर (नासिका के पीछे के गड्ढे) में प्रवेश कराए।

verses.sanskrit: तर्जन्या घंटिकां पूर्वं गृहीत्वाकर्षयेद्बहिः । ततः प्रवेशयेज्जिह्वां शीघ्रं विशति नान्यथा ॥ २२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tarjanyā ghaṃṭikāṃ pūrvaṃ gṛhītvākarṣayedbahiḥ | tataḥ praveśayejjihvāṃ śīghraṃ viśati nānyathā || 229 ||
verses.translation: First catch the uvula with the index finger and pull it forward, then insert the tongue; then it goes in quickly, and not otherwise.
verses.hindi: पहले तर्जनी से घण्टिका को पकड़कर बाहर खींचे, फिर जीभ को भीतर प्रवेश कराए; तब वह शीघ्र प्रवेश करती है, नहीं तो नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: कपालकुहरे जिह्वा प्रविष्टा विपरीतगा । ध्यानं भ्रूमध्यदेशे च मुद्रा भवति खेचरी ॥ २३० ॥
verses.transliteration: kapālakuhare jihvā praviṣṭā viparītagā | dhyānaṃ bhrūmadhyadeśe ca mudrā bhavati khecarī || 230 ||
verses.translation: When the tongue, turned back, has entered the cavity and attention rests between the brows, that is the khechari seal.
verses.hindi: जीभ उलटकर कपाल-कुहर में प्रवेश कर जाए और भौंहों के बीच ध्यान हो, तो यह खेचरी मुद्रा होती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: यथायथा भवेद्दीर्घा जिह्वा यत्नेन योगिनः । तथातथा गुणाधिक्यं विज्ञेयं योगसाधने ॥ २३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: yathāyathā bhaveddīrghā jihvā yatnena yoginaḥ | tathātathā guṇādhikyaṃ vijñeyaṃ yogasādhane || 231 ||
verses.translation: Know that the longer the yogi's tongue becomes through effort, the greater the benefit in the practice of yoga.
verses.hindi: योगी के प्रयत्न से जीभ जितनी-जितनी लम्बी होती है, उतना-उतना योग-साधना में लाभ बढ़ता है, ऐसा जानना चाहिए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: खेचरीमुद्रिकाभ्यासं नित्यमेव समाचरेत् । संध्ययोरुभयोर्योगी जितप्राणो मिताशनः ॥ २३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: khecarīmudrikābhyāsaṃ nityameva samācaret | saṃdhyayorubhayoryogī jitaprāṇo mitāśanaḥ || 232 ||
verses.translation: The yogi who has mastered the breath and eats moderately should practise the khechari seal every day at both twilights.
verses.hindi: प्राण को जीतने वाला और मित आहार वाला योगी दोनों सन्ध्याओं में नित्य खेचरी मुद्रा का अभ्यास करे।

verses.sanskrit: दिनैः कतिपयैरेवमभ्यासं कुर्वतः सदा । योगिनो योगनिद्रा वै समुदेति सुखप्रदा ॥ २३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: dinaiḥ katipayairevamabhyāsaṃ kurvataḥ sadā | yogino yoganidrā vai samudeti sukhapradā || 233 ||
verses.translation: After practising like this constantly for some days, the yogi surely comes to blissful yogic sleep.
verses.hindi: कुछ दिनों तक सदा ऐसा अभ्यास करने पर योगी को सुख देने वाली योगनिद्रा अवश्य होने लगती है।

verses.sanskrit: योगनिद्राचिराभ्यासान्निर्विकल्पः प्रजायते । विस्मृत्य सकलं बाह्यं समाधिस्थो भवेन्नरः ॥ २३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yoganidrācirābhyāsānnirvikalpaḥ prajāyate | vismṛtya sakalaṃ bāhyaṃ samādhistho bhavennaraḥ || 234 ||
verses.translation: Long practice of yogic sleep brings a state without thought; forgetting the whole outer world, one rests in absorption.
verses.hindi: योगनिद्रा के लम्बे अभ्यास से निर्विकल्प अवस्था होती है; सारे बाहरी जगत् को भूलकर मनुष्य समाधि में स्थित हो जाता है।

verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा खेचरीकाले कुर्यात्केवलकुंभकम् । प्राणस्यारोहणं तेन मेरुदंडे प्रजायते ॥ २३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: athavā khecarīkāle kuryātkevalakuṃbhakam | prāṇasyārohaṇaṃ tena merudaṃḍe prajāyate || 235 ||
verses.translation: Or, during khechari, practise retention alone; through it the breath rises in the spine.
verses.hindi: या खेचरी के समय केवल-कुम्भक करे; उससे मेरुदण्ड में प्राण का आरोहण होता है।

verses.sanskrit: क्रमेणाभ्यासतो नित्यं प्राणो हित्वा गमागमौ । ब्रह्मरंध्रे लयं याति समाधिस्थो भवेन्नरः ॥ २३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: krameṇābhyāsato nityaṃ prāṇo hitvā gamāgamau | brahmaraṃdhre layaṃ yāti samādhistho bhavennaraḥ || 236 ||
verses.translation: Through steady daily practice the breath stops coming and going and dissolves at the crown, and one rests in absorption.
verses.hindi: क्रम से नित्य अभ्यास करने पर प्राण आना-जाना छोड़कर ब्रह्मरन्ध्र में लीन हो जाता है, और मनुष्य समाधि में स्थित हो जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: खेचरीमुद्रिकाभ्यासादानंदः स्याद्दिनेदिने । सर्वसंकल्पसंत्यागाज्जगद्विस्मरणं भवेत् ॥ २३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: khecarīmudrikābhyāsādānaṃdaḥ syāddinedine | sarvasaṃkalpasaṃtyāgājjagadvismaraṇaṃ bhavet || 237 ||
verses.translation: Practice of the khechari seal brings bliss day by day, and with all intentions given up, the world is forgotten.
verses.hindi: खेचरी मुद्रा के अभ्यास से दिन-प्रतिदिन आनन्द होता है, और सब संकल्पों के त्याग से जगत् भूल जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: निर्विकल्पसमाधाने मनसो विलयो भवेत् । बाह्यविस्मरणादंतर्दृष्टिः समुपजायते ॥ २३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: nirvikalpasamādhāne manaso vilayo bhavet | bāhyavismaraṇādaṃtardṛṣṭiḥ samupajāyate || 238 ||
verses.translation: In absorption without thought the mind dissolves, and through forgetting the outer world, inner sight is born.
verses.hindi: निर्विकल्प समाधि में मन का लय हो जाता है, और बाहर को भूल जाने से अन्तर्दृष्टि उत्पन्न होती है।

verses.sanskrit: अंतर्दृष्टिप्रकाशो तु त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । दृश्यते स्वसमीपस्थं करामलकवत्स्वयम् ॥ २३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: aṃtardṛṣṭiprakāśo tu trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | dṛśyate svasamīpasthaṃ karāmalakavatsvayam || 239 ||
verses.translation: When inner sight dawns, the three worlds with all that moves and does not move are seen close at hand, like an amla fruit on one's palm.
verses.hindi: अन्तर्दृष्टि का प्रकाश होने पर चर-अचर सहित तीनों लोक हथेली पर रखे आँवले की तरह अपने पास ही दिखाई देते हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यं विस्मृत्य निद्रायां स्वप्नं पश्येन्नरो यथा । समाधिसमये तद्वद्योगी विश्वं प्रपश्यति ॥ २४० ॥
verses.transliteration: bāhyaṃ vismṛtya nidrāyāṃ svapnaṃ paśyennaro yathā | samādhisamaye tadvadyogī viśvaṃ prapaśyati || 240 ||
verses.translation: Just as a person asleep forgets the outer world and sees a dream, so in absorption the yogi sees the universe.
verses.hindi: जैसे नींद में मनुष्य बाहर को भूलकर स्वप्न देखता है, वैसे ही समाधि के समय योगी विश्व को देखता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
