verses.sanskrit: स्वप्नदृष्टपदार्थौघो मृषा भवति निश्चितम् । समाधौ त्वमृषा सर्वं वस्तु कार्यकरं तथा ॥ २४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: svapnadṛṣṭapadārthaugho mṛṣā bhavati niścitam | samādhau tvamṛṣā sarvaṃ vastu kāryakaraṃ tathā || 241 ||
verses.translation: Things seen in a dream are surely false, but in absorption everything is real and of effect.
verses.hindi: स्वप्न में देखी वस्तुएँ निश्चय ही झूठी होती हैं, पर समाधि में सब वस्तुएँ सच्ची और काम आने वाली होती हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: खेचरीयोगतो योगी शिरश्चंद्रादुपागतम् । रसं दिव्यं पिबेन्नित्यं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम् ॥ २४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: khecarīyogato yogī śiraścaṃdrādupāgatam | rasaṃ divyaṃ pibennityaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam || 242 ||
verses.translation: Through khechari yoga the yogi drinks daily the divine fluid flowing from the moon in the head, which destroys every disease.
verses.hindi: खेचरी-योग से योगी सिर के चन्द्रमा से आने वाले दिव्य रस को नित्य पिए, जो सब रोगों का नाश करता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: प्रथमं लवणं पश्चात्क्षारं क्षीरोपमं ततः । द्राक्षारससमं पश्चात्सुधासारमयं ततः ॥ २४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: prathamaṃ lavaṇaṃ paścātkṣāraṃ kṣīropamaṃ tataḥ | drākṣārasasamaṃ paścātsudhāsāramayaṃ tataḥ || 243 ||
verses.translation: (Its taste is) first salty, then alkaline, then like milk, then like grape juice, and then like the very essence of nectar.
verses.hindi: (उसका स्वाद) पहले नमकीन, फिर खारा, फिर दूध जैसा, फिर अंगूर के रस जैसा और फिर अमृत के सार जैसा होता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतास्वादनाद्देहो योगिनो दिव्यतामियात् । जरारोगविनिर्मुक्तश्चिरं जीवति भूतले ॥ २४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: amṛtāsvādanāddeho yogino divyatāmiyāt | jarārogavinirmuktaściraṃ jīvati bhūtale || 244 ||
verses.translation: By tasting the nectar the yogi's body becomes divine; free of old age and disease, he lives long on earth.
verses.hindi: अमृत के स्वाद से योगी की देह दिव्य हो जाती है; वह बुढ़ापे और रोगों से मुक्त होकर पृथ्वी पर बहुत समय तक जीता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अथ नादानुसंधानं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथाक्रमम् । यस्यानुष्ठानतो योगी परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति ॥ २४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: atha nādānusaṃdhānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathākramam | yasyānuṣṭhānato yogī paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || 245 ||
verses.translation: Now I shall describe in order the following of the inner sound, by practising which the yogi reaches the supreme Brahman.
verses.hindi: अब मैं क्रम से नादानुसन्धान (आन्तरिक ध्वनि की खोज) का वर्णन करूँगा, जिसके अनुष्ठान से योगी परब्रह्म को पाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: पद्मासनं समास्थाय स्वस्तिकं वा यथासुखम् । कर्णरंध्रयुगं पश्चादंगुलिभ्यां निरोधयेत् ॥ २४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: padmāsanaṃ samāsthāya svastikaṃ vā yathāsukham | karṇaraṃdhrayugaṃ paścādaṃgulibhyāṃ nirodhayet || 246 ||
verses.translation: Sitting in the lotus or the auspicious pose, whichever is comfortable, then close both ear openings with the fingers.
verses.hindi: पद्मासन या स्वस्तिकासन में, जैसे सुख हो, बैठकर फिर उँगलियों से दोनों कानों के छेद बन्द करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: निमील्य नयने चित्तं कृत्वैकाग्रमनन्यधीः । शृणुयाद्दक्षिणे कर्णे नादमंतर्गतं शुभम् ॥ २४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: nimīlya nayane cittaṃ kṛtvaikāgramananyadhīḥ | śṛṇuyāddakṣiṇe karṇe nādamaṃtargataṃ śubham || 247 ||
verses.translation: With eyes closed and the mind gathered on nothing else, listen in the right ear to the auspicious sound arising within.
verses.hindi: आँखें बन्द करके, अनन्य बुद्धि से चित्त को एकाग्र करके, दाहिने कान में भीतर उठने वाले शुभ नाद को सुने।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णयोस्त्वेकतानेन रोधनं नैव कारयेत् । त्यक्त्वात्यक्त्वांगुलिं मध्ये नादाभ्यासं समाचरेत् ॥ २४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: karṇayostvekatānena rodhanaṃ naiva kārayet | tyaktvātyaktvāṃguliṃ madhye nādābhyāsaṃ samācaret || 248 ||
verses.translation: Do not keep the ears closed without a break; practise the sound while taking the fingers away from time to time.
verses.hindi: कानों को लगातार बन्द न रखे; बीच-बीच में उँगली हटाते हुए नाद का अभ्यास करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अधस्ताद्भुजयोर्द्व्यादाधारं काष्ठनिर्मितम् । श्रवणे तेन नादस्य नैव बाहुश्रमो भवेत् ॥ २४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: adhastādbhujayordvyādādhāraṃ kāṣṭhanirmitam | śravaṇe tena nādasya naiva bāhuśramo bhavet || 249 ||
verses.translation: Place a wooden support under the arms; then the arms do not tire while listening to the sound.
verses.hindi: भुजाओं के नीचे लकड़ी का सहारा रख ले; इससे नाद सुनते समय भुजाओं को थकान नहीं होती।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: श्रूयते प्रथमाभ्यासे ध्वनिर्नादस्य मिश्रितः । ततोभ्यासे स्थिरीभूते श्रूयते तु पृथक्पृथक् ॥ २५० ॥
verses.transliteration: śrūyate prathamābhyāse dhvanirnādasya miśritaḥ | tatobhyāse sthirībhūte śrūyate tu pṛthakpṛthak || 250 ||
verses.translation: In early practice a mixed sound is heard. Then, as practice steadies, the separate sounds are heard one by one.
verses.hindi: पहले अभ्यास में नाद की मिली-जुली ध्वनि सुनाई देती है। फिर अभ्यास स्थिर होने पर अलग-अलग ध्वनियाँ सुनाई देती हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: घंटानादसमः पूर्वं ततः शंखसमो ध्वनिः । वीणारवसमः पश्चात्तालनादोपमस्ततः ॥ २५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: ghaṃṭānādasamaḥ pūrvaṃ tataḥ śaṃkhasamo dhvaniḥ | vīṇāravasamaḥ paścāttālanādopamastataḥ || 251 ||
verses.translation: First a sound like a bell, then like a conch, then like the notes of a vina, then like cymbals.
verses.hindi: पहले घण्टे जैसी ध्वनि, फिर शंख जैसी, फिर वीणा के स्वर जैसी, फिर ताल (करताल) जैसी।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: वंशीशब्दनिभश्चाथो मृदंगसदृशो ध्वनिः । भेरीरवसमः पश्चान्मेघगर्जनसंनिभः ॥ २५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: vaṃśīśabdanibhaścātho mṛdaṃgasadṛśo dhvaniḥ | bherīravasamaḥ paścānmeghagarjanasaṃnibhaḥ || 252 ||
verses.translation: Then like a flute, then like a mridanga drum, then like a kettledrum, and then like the roar of thunderclouds.
verses.hindi: फिर बाँसुरी जैसी, फिर मृदंग जैसी, फिर भेरी (नगाड़े) जैसी और फिर मेघ-गर्जन जैसी ध्वनि होती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: क्रमेणाभ्यासतश्चैवं श्रूयतेऽनाहतो ध्वनिः । पृथग्विमिश्रितश्चापि मनस्तत्र नियोजयेत् ॥ २५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: krameṇābhyāsataścaivaṃ śrūyate'nāhato dhvaniḥ | pṛthagvimiśritaścāpi manastatra niyojayet || 253 ||
verses.translation: Practising in this way, step by step, one hears the unstruck sound, both separately and blended; fix the mind on it.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार क्रम से अभ्यास करने पर अनाहत ध्वनि सुनाई देती है, अलग-अलग भी और मिली-जुली भी; मन को उसी में लगाए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: नादारंभे भवेत्सर्वगात्राणां भंजनं ततः । शिरसः कंपनं पश्चात्सर्वदेहस्य कंपनम् ॥ २५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: nādāraṃbhe bhavetsarvagātrāṇāṃ bhaṃjanaṃ tataḥ | śirasaḥ kaṃpanaṃ paścātsarvadehasya kaṃpanam || 254 ||
verses.translation: When the sound begins there is an aching in all the limbs, then the head trembles, and then the whole body trembles.
verses.hindi: नाद के आरम्भ में सब अंगों में टूटन (ऐंठन) होती है, फिर सिर काँपता है, और फिर सारा शरीर काँपता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: अमृतास्वादनं पश्चाज्जिह्वाग्रे संप्रवर्तते । रोमांचश्च तथानंदः प्रकर्षेणोपजायते ॥ २५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: amṛtāsvādanaṃ paścājjihvāgre saṃpravartate | romāṃcaśca tathānaṃdaḥ prakarṣeṇopajāyate || 255 ||
verses.translation: Then a taste of nectar comes on the tip of the tongue, the hair stands on end, and great joy arises.
verses.hindi: फिर जीभ के अगले भाग पर अमृत का स्वाद आने लगता है, रोमांच होता है और बहुत अधिक आनन्द उत्पन्न होता है।

verses.sanskrit: नादश्रवणतो योऽसावानंदो योगिनो भवेत् । शक्यते स गिरा वक्तुं मया नात्र कथंचन ॥ २५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: nādaśravaṇato yo'sāvānaṃdo yogino bhavet | śakyate sa girā vaktuṃ mayā nātra kathaṃcana || 256 ||
verses.translation: The bliss a yogi feels from hearing the inner sound I cannot put into words here in any way.
verses.hindi: नाद सुनने से योगी को जो आनन्द होता है, उसे मैं यहाँ किसी भी प्रकार वाणी से नहीं कह सकता।

verses.sanskrit: आरंभो योगनिद्रायास्ततः समुपजायते । सर्वं देहादि विस्मृत्य समाधिस्थो भवेन्नरः ॥ २५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: āraṃbho yoganidrāyāstataḥ samupajāyate | sarvaṃ dehādi vismṛtya samādhistho bhavennaraḥ || 257 ||
verses.translation: Then yogic sleep begins; forgetting the body and everything else, one rests in absorption.
verses.hindi: फिर योगनिद्रा का आरम्भ होता है; देह आदि सब कुछ भूलकर मनुष्य समाधि में स्थित हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अथवा नादयोगेन शरीरे कृशतां गते । सर्वांगेभ्यो भवेत्तूर्णं प्राणस्याकर्षणं ध्रुवम् ॥ २५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: athavā nādayogena śarīre kṛśatāṃ gate | sarvāṃgebhyo bhavettūrṇaṃ prāṇasyākarṣaṇaṃ dhruvam || 258 ||
verses.translation: Or, when the body has grown lean through the yoga of sound, the breath is surely drawn in quickly from all the limbs.
verses.hindi: या नाद-योग से शरीर दुबला हो जाने पर सब अंगों से प्राण का शीघ्र आकर्षण (खिंचाव) निश्चय ही होता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: तं ध्यानेनोर्ध्वमानीय ब्रह्मरंध्रे प्रवेशयेत् । तत्रैव स्थिरतां नीत्वा समाधिस्थो भवेन्नरः ॥ २५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṃ dhyānenordhvamānīya brahmaraṃdhre praveśayet | tatraiva sthiratāṃ nītvā samādhistho bhavennaraḥ || 259 ||
verses.translation: Bringing it upward through meditation, one should make it enter the crown; holding it steady there, one rests in absorption.
verses.hindi: उसे ध्यान से ऊपर लाकर ब्रह्मरन्ध्र में प्रवेश कराए; वहीं स्थिर करके मनुष्य समाधि में स्थित हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: नादश्रवणतो नित्यमंतर्लीनं भवेन्मनः । न च बाह्यं विजानाति कूपे मग्न इव द्विपः ॥ २६० ॥
verses.transliteration: nādaśravaṇato nityamaṃtarlīnaṃ bhavenmanaḥ | na ca bāhyaṃ vijānāti kūpe magna iva dvipaḥ || 260 ||
verses.translation: Through hearing the inner sound daily, the mind sinks within and knows nothing of the outside, like an elephant sunk in a well.
verses.hindi: नित्य नाद सुनने से मन भीतर लीन हो जाता है, और वह कुएँ में डूबे हाथी की तरह बाहर का कुछ नहीं जानता।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अंतर्लीनमना योगी जगत्सर्वं प्रपश्यति । सर्वगुप्तपदार्थानां प्रत्यक्षत्वं च जायते ॥ २६१ ॥
verses.transliteration: aṃtarlīnamanā yogī jagatsarvaṃ prapaśyati | sarvaguptapadārthānāṃ pratyakṣatvaṃ ca jāyate || 261 ||
verses.translation: The yogi whose mind is absorbed within sees the whole world, and everything hidden becomes plain before him.
verses.hindi: भीतर लीन मन वाला योगी सारे जगत् को देखता है, और सब छिपी वस्तुएँ उसके सामने प्रत्यक्ष हो जाती हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: अंतर्धानस्य शक्तिश्च योगिनो भवति ध्रुवम् । सङ्कल्पानुविधायित्वं शरीरस्योपजायते ॥ २६२ ॥
verses.transliteration: aṃtardhānasya śaktiśca yogino bhavati dhruvam | saṅkalpānuvidhāyitvaṃ śarīrasyopajāyate || 262 ||
verses.translation: The yogi surely gains the power to become invisible too, and his body comes to follow his will.
verses.hindi: योगी में अदृश्य होने की शक्ति भी निश्चय ही आ जाती है, और उसका शरीर संकल्प के अनुसार चलने लगता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: यथा संकल्पयेद्देहं यथारूपं यथागुणम् । तथैव जायते सद्यः शरीरं योगिनो ध्रुवम् ॥ २६३ ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā saṃkalpayeddehaṃ yathārūpaṃ yathāguṇam | tathaiva jāyate sadyaḥ śarīraṃ yogino dhruvam || 263 ||
verses.translation: Whatever shape, form and qualities the yogi wills for his body, his body surely becomes just that at once.
verses.hindi: योगी जिस आकार, रूप और गुण वाली देह का संकल्प करे, उसका शरीर निश्चय ही तुरन्त वैसा ही हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: एकस्मिन्नेव काले च शरीराणि बहून्यपि । निर्माय विहरेल्लोके पुनश्चैको भवेत्क्षणात् ॥ २६४ ॥
verses.transliteration: ekasminneva kāle ca śarīrāṇi bahūnyapi | nirmāya viharelloke punaścaiko bhavetkṣaṇāt || 264 ||
verses.translation: Making many bodies at one and the same time, he moves about the world, and in a moment becomes one again.
verses.hindi: एक ही समय में बहुत से शरीर बनाकर वह संसार में विचरता है, और फिर क्षण भर में एक हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च वेत्ति सर्वं सकारणम् । ध्यानमात्रेण सर्वेषां भूतानां च मनोगतम् ॥ २६५ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca vetti sarvaṃ sakāraṇam | dhyānamātreṇa sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca manogatam || 265 ||
verses.translation: He knows past, present and future, all with their causes, and by meditation alone he knows what is in the minds of all beings.
verses.hindi: वह भूत, वर्तमान और भविष्य सबको उनके कारणों सहित जानता है, और केवल ध्यान से सब प्राणियों के मन की बात भी जान लेता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्गेऽन्तरिक्षे पाताले तथा भूमंडलेऽखिले । अव्याहतगतिर्योगी स्वेच्छया विचरेच्चिरम् ॥ २६६ ॥
verses.transliteration: svarge'ntarikṣe pātāle tathā bhūmaṃḍale'khile | avyāhatagatiryogī svecchayā vicarecciram || 266 ||
verses.translation: With unhindered movement through heaven, the middle air, the netherworld and the whole earth, the yogi roams at will for a long time.
verses.hindi: स्वर्ग, अन्तरिक्ष, पाताल और सारे भूमण्डल में बिना रुकावट की गति वाला योगी अपनी इच्छा से बहुत समय तक विचरता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: त्राटकाभ्यासतश्चापि कालेन क्रमयोगतः । राजयोगसमाधिः स्यात्तत्प्रकारोऽधुनोच्यते ॥ २६७ ॥
verses.transliteration: trāṭakābhyāsataścāpi kālena kramayogataḥ | rājayogasamādhiḥ syāttatprakāro'dhunocyate || 267 ||
verses.translation: Raja-yoga absorption also comes in time, stage by stage, through practice of fixed gazing. Its method is now described.
verses.hindi: समय के साथ क्रम से त्राटक के अभ्यास से भी राजयोग की समाधि होती है। अब उसकी विधि बताई जाती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: श्वेतमृत्स्ना प्रलिप्तायां भित्तौ कृत्वा मसीमयम् । वर्तुलाकारकं बिंदुं दूरस्थस्तं विलोकयेत् ॥ २६८ ॥
verses.transliteration: śvetamṛtsnā praliptāyāṃ bhittau kṛtvā masīmayam | vartulākārakaṃ biṃduṃ dūrasthastaṃ vilokayet || 268 ||
verses.translation: On a wall plastered with white clay, make a round dot with ink, and gaze at it from a distance.
verses.hindi: सफ़ेद मिट्टी से लीपी हुई दीवार पर स्याही से एक गोल बिन्दु बनाकर, दूर बैठकर उसे देखे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: सुखासने समासीनो निर्जनस्थानगः सदा । निमेषवर्जितं नेत्रं शनैस्तत्र नियोजयेत् ॥ २६९ ॥
verses.transliteration: sukhāsane samāsīno nirjanasthānagaḥ sadā | nimeṣavarjitaṃ netraṃ śanaistatra niyojayet || 269 ||
verses.translation: Sitting always in a solitary place in a comfortable pose, slowly fix the eyes there without blinking.
verses.hindi: सदा निर्जन स्थान में सुखासन से बैठकर, धीरे-धीरे बिना पलक झपकाए आँखों को वहाँ लगाए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्या समं मनश्चापि लक्ष्यस्थाने प्रवेशयेत् । लक्ष्यं विहाय नैवान्यच्चिंतयेन्नावलोकयेत् ॥ २७० ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭyā samaṃ manaścāpi lakṣyasthāne praveśayet | lakṣyaṃ vihāya naivānyacciṃtayennāvalokayet || 270 ||
verses.translation: Along with the gaze, place the mind too on the target. Apart from the target, think of nothing else and look at nothing else.
verses.hindi: दृष्टि के साथ मन को भी लक्ष्य के स्थान पर लगाए। लक्ष्य को छोड़कर कुछ और न सोचे, न देखे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: दिवा निरीक्षयेद्बिंदुं रात्रौ नक्षत्रमुज्ज्वलम् । दीपं वा दूरतो धृत्वा क्रमान्नित्यं समभ्यसेत् ॥ २७१ ॥
verses.transliteration: divā nirīkṣayedbiṃduṃ rātrau nakṣatramujjvalam | dīpaṃ vā dūrato dhṛtvā kramānnityaṃ samabhyaset || 271 ||
verses.translation: By day gaze at the dot, by night at a bright star, or at a lamp set at a distance; practise like this daily, step by step.
verses.hindi: दिन में बिन्दु को देखे, रात में किसी चमकते तारे को, या दूर रखे दीपक को; इस प्रकार क्रम से नित्य अभ्यास करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: यथा धन्वी स्वकं लक्ष्यं वेधयत्यचलेक्षणः । तथैव त्राटकाभ्यासं कुर्यादेकाग्रमानसः ॥ २७२ ॥
verses.transliteration: yathā dhanvī svakaṃ lakṣyaṃ vedhayatyacalekṣaṇaḥ | tathaiva trāṭakābhyāsaṃ kuryādekāgramānasaḥ || 272 ||
verses.translation: Just as an archer pierces his target with an unwavering eye, so practise fixed gazing with a one-pointed mind.
verses.hindi: जैसे धनुर्धारी अचल दृष्टि से अपने लक्ष्य को भेदता है, वैसे ही एकाग्र मन से त्राटक का अभ्यास करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: यदा मुहूर्तपर्यंतं निमेषोन्मेषवर्जिता । स्थिरा दृष्टिर्भवेत्तत्र सिद्धः स्यात्त्राटकस्तदा ॥ २७३ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā muhūrtaparyaṃtaṃ nimeṣonmeṣavarjitā | sthirā dṛṣṭirbhavettatra siddhaḥ syāttrāṭakastadā || 273 ||
verses.translation: When the gaze stays fixed there for a muhurta without blinking, the fixed gaze is mastered.
verses.hindi: जब एक मुहूर्त तक बिना पलक झपकाए और बिना खोले दृष्टि वहाँ स्थिर रहे, तब त्राटक सिद्ध होता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.
verses.lifeLesson: Care for the physical body not out of vanity, but as a consecrated temple and instrument for self-knowledge and service.

verses.sanskrit: दृश्यते प्रथमाभ्यासे तेजो बिंदुसमीपगम् । चक्षुषो रश्मिजालानि प्रसरंति समंततः ॥ २७४ ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛśyate prathamābhyāse tejo biṃdusamīpagam | cakṣuṣo raśmijālāni prasaraṃti samaṃtataḥ || 274 ||
verses.translation: In early practice a light is seen near the dot, and nets of rays spread out from the eyes in all directions.
verses.hindi: पहले अभ्यास में बिन्दु के पास प्रकाश दिखाई देता है, और आँखों से किरणों के जाल चारों ओर फैलते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तेजसा संवृतं लक्ष्यं क्षणं लुप्तं भवेत्ततः । क्षणं दृष्टिगतं भूत्वा पुनर्लुप्तं भवेत्क्षणात् ॥ २७५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tejasā saṃvṛtaṃ lakṣyaṃ kṣaṇaṃ luptaṃ bhavettataḥ | kṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭigataṃ bhūtvā punarluptaṃ bhavetkṣaṇāt || 275 ||
verses.translation: Covered by light, the target vanishes for a moment; then it is seen for a moment, and vanishes again in a moment.
verses.hindi: प्रकाश से ढका हुआ लक्ष्य क्षण भर के लिए लुप्त हो जाता है; फिर क्षण भर दिखकर फिर क्षण में लुप्त हो जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: वर्धमाने ततोऽभ्यासे लक्ष्यं हित्वा शनैःशनैः । दृष्टिरंतर्मुखत्वेन लीयते मनसा समम् ॥ २७६ ॥
verses.transliteration: vardhamāne tato'bhyāse lakṣyaṃ hitvā śanaiḥśanaiḥ | dṛṣṭiraṃtarmukhatvena līyate manasā samam || 276 ||
verses.translation: Then, as practice grows, the gaze slowly leaves the target, turns inward, and dissolves together with the mind.
verses.hindi: फिर अभ्यास बढ़ने पर धीरे-धीरे लक्ष्य को छोड़कर दृष्टि भीतर की ओर मुड़कर मन के साथ लीन हो जाती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: यथैवावस्थितं तत्र शरीरं योगिनो भवेत् । तथैव प्रतिमाकारं निश्चलं जायते ध्रुवम् ॥ २७७ ॥
verses.transliteration: yathaivāvasthitaṃ tatra śarīraṃ yogino bhavet | tathaiva pratimākāraṃ niścalaṃ jāyate dhruvam || 277 ||
verses.translation: Then the yogi's body, just as it sits, surely becomes as motionless as a statue.
verses.hindi: तब योगी का शरीर जैसा बैठा होता है, वैसा ही निश्चय ही मूर्ति के समान निश्चल हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: क्षणमंतर्मुखो भूत्वा पुनरुत्थानकं व्रजेत् । ततो निरीक्षयेल्लक्ष्यं पुनरंतर्मुखो भवेत् ॥ २७८ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣaṇamaṃtarmukho bhūtvā punarutthānakaṃ vrajet | tato nirīkṣayellakṣyaṃ punaraṃtarmukho bhavet || 278 ||
verses.translation: After turning inward for a moment, one comes up again; then one should gaze at the target and turn inward again.
verses.hindi: क्षण भर भीतर मुड़ा रहकर फिर (साधारण अवस्था में) उठ आता है; फिर लक्ष्य को देखे और फिर भीतर मुड़ जाए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कुर्वन्सदाभ्यासं त्राटकस्य विधानतः । चिराभ्यासवशाद्योगी समाधिस्थो भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ २७९ ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṃ kurvansadābhyāsaṃ trāṭakasya vidhānataḥ | cirābhyāsavaśādyogī samādhistho bhaveddhruvam || 279 ||
verses.translation: Practising fixed gazing in this way, always according to the method, the yogi surely comes to rest in absorption through long practice.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार विधि से सदा त्राटक का अभ्यास करते हुए, लम्बे अभ्यास के बल से योगी निश्चय ही समाधि में स्थित हो जाता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: समाध्यभ्यासतो नित्यं जायतेऽंतर्मनोलयः । अंतर्दृष्टिप्रकाशश्च तस्य संजायते क्रमात् ॥ २८० ॥
verses.transliteration: samādhyabhyāsato nityaṃ jāyate'ṃtarmanolayaḥ | aṃtardṛṣṭiprakāśaśca tasya saṃjāyate kramāt || 280 ||
verses.translation: Through daily practice of absorption the mind dissolves within, and the light of inner sight gradually dawns in him.
verses.hindi: नित्य समाधि के अभ्यास से मन भीतर लीन हो जाता है, और क्रम से उसमें अन्तर्दृष्टि का प्रकाश उत्पन्न होता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: करामलकवद्विश्वं तेन योगी प्रपश्यति । दूरतो दर्शनं दूरश्रवणं चापि जायते ॥ २८१ ॥
verses.transliteration: karāmalakavadviśvaṃ tena yogī prapaśyati | dūrato darśanaṃ dūraśravaṇaṃ cāpi jāyate || 281 ||
verses.translation: By it the yogi sees the universe like an amla fruit on his palm, and gains the power to see and hear things far away.
verses.hindi: उससे योगी विश्व को हथेली पर रखे आँवले की तरह देखता है, और उसे दूर-दर्शन और दूर-श्रवण की शक्ति भी आ जाती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: यदुक्तं खेचरीयोगे यच्चोक्तं नादचिंतने । तत्सर्वं त्राटकाभ्यासाद्योगिनो भवति ध्रुवम् ॥ २८२ ॥
verses.transliteration: yaduktaṃ khecarīyoge yaccoktaṃ nādaciṃtane | tatsarvaṃ trāṭakābhyāsādyogino bhavati dhruvam || 282 ||
verses.translation: All that was said of khechari yoga and all that was said of meditation on sound surely comes to the yogi through fixed gazing too.
verses.hindi: जो खेचरी-योग में कहा गया और जो नाद-चिन्तन में कहा गया, वह सब त्राटक के अभ्यास से भी योगी को निश्चय ही मिलता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अणिमादिगुणैर्युक्तो विचरेद्भुवनत्रये । स्वेच्छया देहमुत्सृज्य कैवल्यं पदमश्नुते ॥ २८३ ॥
verses.transliteration: aṇimādiguṇairyukto vicaredbhuvanatraye | svecchayā dehamutsṛjya kaivalyaṃ padamaśnute || 283 ||
verses.translation: Endowed with powers such as minuteness, he roams the three worlds, and leaving the body at will, he attains liberation.
verses.hindi: अणिमा आदि गुणों से युक्त होकर वह तीनों लोकों में विचरता है, और अपनी इच्छा से देह छोड़कर कैवल्य पद पाता है।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं योगस्यांगाष्टकं क्रमात् । सर्वेषां योगतंत्राणां सारभूतमसंशयम् ॥ २८४ ॥
verses.transliteration: etatsaṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ yogasyāṃgāṣṭakaṃ kramāt | sarveṣāṃ yogataṃtrāṇāṃ sārabhūtamasaṃśayam || 284 ||
verses.translation: So the eight limbs of yoga have been told briefly and in order; they are without doubt the essence of all the texts of yoga.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार संक्षेप में क्रम से योग के आठ अंग बताए गए, जो निःसन्देह सब योग-ग्रन्थों का सार हैं।

verses.sanskrit: नात्र किंचिदयुक्तं वा नाधिकं किंचिदीरितम् । यथानुभूतं दृष्टं च तदेवात्र निरूपितम् ॥ २८५ ॥
verses.transliteration: nātra kiṃcidayuktaṃ vā nādhikaṃ kiṃcidīritam | yathānubhūtaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ca tadevātra nirūpitam || 285 ||
verses.translation: Nothing improper and nothing excessive has been said here. What has been set out is just what was experienced and seen.
verses.hindi: यहाँ कुछ भी अनुचित या अधिक नहीं कहा गया। जैसा अनुभव किया और देखा, वही यहाँ बताया गया है।

verses.sanskrit: तस्मादास्तिकभावेन कुर्याद्योगस्य साधनम् । अवश्यं सिद्धिमाप्नोति निर्वेदान्न जहाति चेत् ॥ २८६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmādāstikabhāvena kuryādyogasya sādhanam | avaśyaṃ siddhimāpnoti nirvedānna jahāti cet || 286 ||
verses.translation: So practise yoga in a spirit of faith. If one does not give it up in discouragement, one surely succeeds.
verses.hindi: इसलिए आस्था के भाव से योग की साधना करे। यदि निराश होकर उसे न छोड़े, तो अवश्य सिद्धि पाता है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रायशो योगयुक्तीनां संनिवेशोऽत्र विद्यते । तथापि गुरुवक्त्रेण विज्ञेयास्ता विचक्षणैः ॥ २८७ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāyaśo yogayuktīnāṃ saṃniveśo'tra vidyate | tathāpi guruvaktreṇa vijñeyāstā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 287 ||
verses.translation: Most of the techniques of yoga are included here; even so, the wise should learn them from a teacher's own mouth.
verses.hindi: यहाँ योग की अधिकतर युक्तियों का समावेश है, फिर भी बुद्धिमानों को उन्हें गुरु के मुख से ही जानना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: हठयोगस्य सम्प्रोक्तो राजयोगस्य वै तथा । विधिरत्र समासेन क्रमादभ्यासमाचरेत् ॥ २८८ ॥
verses.transliteration: haṭhayogasya samprokto rājayogasya vai tathā | vidhiratra samāsena kramādabhyāsamācaret || 288 ||
verses.translation: The method of hatha yoga and of raja yoga have both been set out here in brief; practise them in order.
verses.hindi: यहाँ हठयोग और राजयोग, दोनों की विधि संक्षेप में बताई गई है; क्रम से उनका अभ्यास करे।

verses.sanskrit: सततं तु हठाभ्यासं नैव कुर्याद्विचक्षणः । साधयित्वा हठं पूर्वं राजयोगं ततोऽभ्यसेत् ॥ २८९ ॥
verses.transliteration: satataṃ tu haṭhābhyāsaṃ naiva kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | sādhayitvā haṭhaṃ pūrvaṃ rājayogaṃ tato'bhyaset || 289 ||
verses.translation: The wise practitioner should not practise hatha alone without end. First master hatha, then practise raja yoga.
verses.hindi: बुद्धिमान साधक लगातार केवल हठ का ही अभ्यास न करे। पहले हठ को सिद्ध करके फिर राजयोग का अभ्यास करे।

verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषु योगमार्गेषु शरीरं कृशतां व्रजेत् । भयं तत्र न कुर्वीत युक्त्या रक्षेत्कलेवरम् ॥ २९० ॥
verses.transliteration: sarveṣu yogamārgeṣu śarīraṃ kṛśatāṃ vrajet | bhayaṃ tatra na kurvīta yuktyā rakṣetkalevaram || 290 ||
verses.translation: On every path of yoga the body becomes lean. Do not be afraid of it, but protect the body with care.
verses.hindi: योग के सब मार्गों में शरीर दुबला हो जाता है। उससे डरे नहीं, पर युक्ति से शरीर की रक्षा करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: वर्जयेद्दशनं रूक्षं स्नानं शीतांबुना तथा । पथ्यां पर्यटनं चैव स्त्रियं चापि विशेषतः ॥ २९१ ॥
verses.transliteration: varjayeddaśanaṃ rūkṣaṃ snānaṃ śītāṃbunā tathā | pathyāṃ paryaṭanaṃ caiva striyaṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ || 291 ||
verses.translation: Give up dry food, bathing in cold water, long journeys on foot, and above all sexual contact.
verses.hindi: रूखा भोजन, ठण्डे पानी से स्नान, अधिक पैदल यात्रा और विशेष रूप से स्त्री-संग छोड़ दे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: नातिशीते न चात्युष्णे नातिवर्षति तोयदे । अभ्यासं वर्धयेद्योगी नो चेद्रोगभयं ध्रुवम् ॥ २९२ ॥
verses.transliteration: nātiśīte na cātyuṣṇe nātivarṣati toyade | abhyāsaṃ vardhayedyogī no cedrogabhayaṃ dhruvam || 292 ||
verses.translation: The yogi should not increase practice in great cold, great heat or heavy rain; otherwise there is sure danger of illness.
verses.hindi: बहुत ठण्ड, बहुत गर्मी और भारी वर्षा के समय योगी अभ्यास न बढ़ाए; नहीं तो रोग का भय निश्चित है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.
verses.science: Mitochondrial vitality and neuroendocrine balance: yogic practices stimulate cellular autophagy and optimal metabolic resilience.

verses.sanskrit: देशोऽनुकूले काले च समे स्थाने च निर्मले । वर्धयन्नित्यमभ्यासं ध्रुवं सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् ॥ २९३ ॥
verses.transliteration: deśo'nukūle kāle ca same sthāne ca nirmale | vardhayannityamabhyāsaṃ dhruvaṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt || 293 ||
verses.translation: In a favourable place and season, on level and clean ground, increasing practice daily, one surely gains success.
verses.hindi: अनुकूल देश और समय में, समतल और स्वच्छ स्थान पर, नित्य अभ्यास बढ़ाता हुआ (साधक) निश्चय ही सिद्धि पाता है।

verses.sanskrit: प्राणस्यारोहणे वापि परकायप्रवेशने । शरीरमोक्षणे चादौ भोजनं परिवर्जयेत् ॥ २९४ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇasyārohaṇe vāpi parakāyapraveśane | śarīramokṣaṇe cādau bhojanaṃ parivarjayet || 294 ||
verses.translation: Before practising the raising of the breath, entering another body, or leaving the body, one should not eat.
verses.hindi: प्राण को ऊपर चढ़ाने, दूसरी देह में प्रवेश करने और शरीर छोड़ने के अभ्यास के आरम्भ में भोजन न करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: निराशनादग्निस्तूर्णं जाठरो दाहकृद्भवेत् । काले तदुपशांत्यर्थं क्षीरं नीरान्वितं पिबेत् ॥ २९५ ॥
verses.transliteration: nirāśanādagnistūrṇaṃ jāṭharo dāhakṛdbhavet | kāle tadupaśāṃtyarthaṃ kṣīraṃ nīrānvitaṃ pibet || 295 ||
verses.translation: Fasting soon makes the digestive fire burn; to calm it, drink milk mixed with water at the proper time.
verses.hindi: उपवास से जठराग्नि शीघ्र जलन करने लगती है; उसे शान्त करने के लिए समय पर पानी मिला दूध पिए।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: स्वतो वा परतो वापि प्रबंधं सर्वमादितः । स्थानशिष्याशनादीनां कृत्वा योगं समभ्यसेत् ॥ २९६ ॥
verses.transliteration: svato vā parato vāpi prabaṃdhaṃ sarvamāditaḥ | sthānaśiṣyāśanādīnāṃ kṛtvā yogaṃ samabhyaset || 296 ||
verses.translation: First arrange everything, by oneself or through others: the place, a student, food and the rest; then practise yoga.
verses.hindi: स्वयं या दूसरे के द्वारा, पहले स्थान, शिष्य, भोजन आदि सबका प्रबन्ध करके फिर योग का अभ्यास करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: योगाभ्यासे प्रवृत्तस्तु शीघ्रं सिद्धिं न कामयेत् । कालेन दुरिते क्षीणे स्वतः सिद्धिः प्रजायते ॥ २९७ ॥
verses.transliteration: yogābhyāse pravṛttastu śīghraṃ siddhiṃ na kāmayet | kālena durite kṣīṇe svataḥ siddhiḥ prajāyate || 297 ||
verses.translation: One engaged in yoga should not hanker for quick success. When wrongdoing wears away in time, success comes of itself.
verses.hindi: योग के अभ्यास में लगा व्यक्ति शीघ्र सिद्धि की इच्छा न करे। समय के साथ पाप क्षीण होने पर सिद्धि अपने आप होती है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: शास्त्रवाक्येषु विश्वासो गुरुपादाब्जसेवनम् । भक्तिर्विष्णौ शिवे वापि योगस्य सिद्धिहेतवः ॥ २९८ ॥
verses.transliteration: śāstravākyeṣu viśvāso gurupādābjasevanam | bhaktirviṣṇau śive vāpi yogasya siddhihetavaḥ || 298 ||
verses.translation: Faith in the words of scripture, service at the teacher's lotus feet, and devotion to Vishnu or to Shiva: these are the causes of success in yoga.
verses.hindi: शास्त्र के वचनों में विश्वास, गुरु के चरण-कमलों की सेवा, और विष्णु या शिव में भक्ति, ये योग की सिद्धि के कारण हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: पथ्याशिनो विरक्तस्य शांतस्यैकांतवासिनः । दृढचित्तस्य धीरस्य योगः सिद्ध्यति सत्वरम् ॥ २९९ ॥
verses.transliteration: pathyāśino viraktasya śāṃtasyaikāṃtavāsinaḥ | dṛḍhacittasya dhīrasya yogaḥ siddhyati satvaram || 299 ||
verses.translation: For one who eats wholesome food, is detached, calm, lives in solitude, and is firm of mind and steady, yoga soon succeeds.
verses.hindi: जो पथ्य भोजन करता है, विरक्त है, शान्त है, एकान्त में रहता है, दृढ़ चित्त वाला और धीर है, उसका योग शीघ्र सिद्ध होता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: विघ्ना बहुविधा योगे भवंतीति विनिश्चितम् । तथापि साधयेद्योगी योगं धृतिपरायणः ॥ ३०० ॥
verses.transliteration: vighnā bahuvidhā yoge bhavaṃtīti viniścitam | tathāpi sādhayedyogī yogaṃ dhṛtiparāyaṇaḥ || 300 ||
verses.translation: It is certain that many kinds of obstacles arise in yoga; even so, holding fast to patience, the yogi should practise yoga.
verses.hindi: यह निश्चित है कि योग में अनेक प्रकार के विघ्न आते हैं; फिर भी धैर्य को धारण करके योगी योग की साधना करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: प्रणवस्य जपं कुर्याद्योगारंभे सदा बुधः । तदर्थमीश्वरं चापि चिंतयेच्चेतसा मुहुः ॥ ३०१ ॥
verses.transliteration: praṇavasya japaṃ kuryādyogāraṃbhe sadā budhaḥ | tadarthamīśvaraṃ cāpi ciṃtayeccetasā muhuḥ || 301 ||
verses.translation: At the start of yoga the wise should always repeat Om, and again and again reflect in the mind on the Lord who is its meaning:
verses.hindi: बुद्धिमान साधक योग के आरम्भ में सदा प्रणव (ॐ) का जप करे, और उसके अर्थ रूप ईश्वर का भी बार-बार मन से चिन्तन करे।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वज्ञं सर्वगं शुद्धं दयालुं सर्वकारणम् । विघ्नास्तेन विनश्यंति तमांस्यर्कोदये यथा ॥ ३०२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ śuddhaṃ dayāluṃ sarvakāraṇam | vighnāstena vinaśyaṃti tamāṃsyarkodaye yathā || 302 ||
verses.translation: all-knowing, all-pervading, pure, compassionate, the cause of all. Through this, obstacles vanish as darkness does at sunrise.
verses.hindi: जो सर्वज्ञ, सर्वव्यापी, शुद्ध, दयालु और सबका कारण है। उससे विघ्न वैसे ही नष्ट हो जाते हैं जैसे सूर्योदय होने पर अँधेरा।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यासानंतरं कुर्यादगच्छंस्तिष्ठन्स्वपन्नपि । चिंतनं हंसमंत्रस्य योगसिद्धिकरं परम् ॥ ३०३ ॥
verses.transliteration: abhyāsānaṃtaraṃ kuryādagacchaṃstiṣṭhansvapannapi | ciṃtanaṃ haṃsamaṃtrasya yogasiddhikaraṃ param || 303 ||
verses.translation: After practice, whether walking, standing or even lying down, reflect on the hamsa mantra, the supreme means of success in yoga.
verses.hindi: अभ्यास के बाद चलते, खड़े और सोते हुए भी हंस-मन्त्र का चिन्तन करे, जो योग की सिद्धि देने वाला परम (साधन) है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: हकारेण बहिर्याति सकारेण पुनर्विशेत् । प्राणः सर्वशरीरेषु श्वासोच्छ्वासक्रमेण वै ॥ ३०४ ॥
verses.transliteration: hakāreṇa bahiryāti sakāreṇa punarviśet | prāṇaḥ sarvaśarīreṣu śvāsocchvāsakrameṇa vai || 304 ||
verses.translation: In every body the breath goes out with the sound 'ha' and comes back in with the sound 'sa', in the rhythm of breathing out and in.
verses.hindi: सब शरीरों में प्राण साँस छोड़ने और लेने के क्रम से 'ह' कार के साथ बाहर जाता है और 'स' कार के साथ फिर भीतर आता है।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: हंसोहंसोहमित्येवं पुनरावर्त्तनक्रमात् । सोहं सोहं भवेन्नूनमिति योगविदो विदुः ॥ ३०५ ॥
verses.transliteration: haṃsohaṃsohamityevaṃ punarāvarttanakramāt | sohaṃ sohaṃ bhavennūnamiti yogavido viduḥ || 305 ||
verses.translation: Repeated over and over as 'hamso hamso ham', it surely becomes 'soham soham', 'I am That', as the knowers of yoga know.
verses.hindi: 'हंसो हंसो हम्' इस प्रकार बार-बार दोहराने के क्रम से वह निश्चय ही 'सोऽहं सोऽहं' (वह मैं हूँ) हो जाता है, ऐसा योग के ज्ञाता जानते हैं।
verses.explanation: In this verse, the text integrates Ayurvedic rasayana principles with esoteric Hatha Yoga, treating physical health as the foundation for steady meditation.

verses.sanskrit: अजपानाम गायत्री निरंतरजपात्मिका । गिरिजायै पुरा प्रोक्ता शिवेनेयं सुसिद्धिदा ॥ ३०६ ॥
verses.transliteration: ajapānāma gāyatrī niraṃtarajapātmikā | girijāyai purā proktā śiveneyaṃ susiddhidā || 306 ||
verses.translation: This is the Gayatri called ajapa, whose repetition goes on unceasingly by itself. Long ago Shiva taught this giver of the highest success to Parvati.
verses.hindi: यह अजपा नाम की गायत्री है, जिसका जप निरन्तर अपने आप होता रहता है। यह उत्तम सिद्धि देने वाली (गायत्री) पहले शिव ने पार्वती को बताई थी।

verses.sanskrit: अस्याश्चिंतनतो नित्यं सर्वदुष्कृतराशयः । योगिनां नाशमायांति तृणभारा यथाग्निना ॥ ३०७ ॥
verses.transliteration: asyāściṃtanato nityaṃ sarvaduṣkṛtarāśayaḥ | yogināṃ nāśamāyāṃti tṛṇabhārā yathāgninā || 307 ||
verses.translation: By reflecting on it daily, all the heaps of a yogi's wrongdoing are destroyed, as bundles of grass are by fire.
verses.hindi: इसके नित्य चिन्तन से योगियों के सब पापों के ढेर वैसे ही नष्ट हो जाते हैं जैसे आग से घास के गट्ठर।

verses.sanskrit: क्रमेणाभ्यासयोगेन जायतेंऽतर्मनोलयः । प्राणश्च क्षीणतां याति योगनिद्रा प्रजायते ॥ ३०८ ॥
verses.transliteration: krameṇābhyāsayogena jāyateṃ'tarmanolayaḥ | prāṇaśca kṣīṇatāṃ yāti yoganidrā prajāyate || 308 ||
verses.translation: Through steady practice, step by step, the mind dissolves within, the breath grows faint, and yogic sleep arises.
verses.hindi: क्रम से अभ्यास-योग से मन भीतर लीन हो जाता है, प्राण क्षीण हो जाता है और योगनिद्रा उत्पन्न होती है।
